text_en: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians: and he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and in writing also, saying:
text_la: In anno primo Cyri regis Persarum, ut compleretur verbum Domini ex ore Jeremiæ, suscitavit Dominus spiritum Cyri regis Persarum : et traduxit vocem in omni regno suo, etiam per scripturam, dicens:
text_pt: No primeiro ano de Ciro, rei da Pérsia (para que se cumprisse a palavra do SENHOR, pela boca de Jeremias), despertou o SENHOR o espírito de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, o qual fez passar pregão por todo o seu reino, como também por escrito, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ πρώτῳ ἔτει Κύρου τοῦ βασιλέως Περσῶν τοῦ τελεσθῆναι λόγον κυρίου ἀπὸ στόματος Ιερεμιου ἐξήγειρεν κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα Κύρου βασιλέως Περσῶν καὶ παρήγγειλεν φωνὴν ἐν πάσῃ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ καί γε ἐν γραπτῷ λέγων

text_en: Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord the God of heaven has given to me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem , which is in Judea .
text_la: Hæc dicit Cyrus rex Persarum : Omnia regna terræ dedit mihi Dominus Deus cæli, et ipse præcepit mihi ut ædificarem ei domum in Jerusalem, quæ est in Judæa.
text_pt: Assim diz Ciro, rei da Pérsia: O Senhor Deus dos céus me deu todos os reinos da terra, e me encarregou de lhe edificar uma casa em Jerusalém, que está em Judá.
text_el: οὕτως εἶπεν Κῦρος βασιλεὺς Περσῶν πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τῆς γῆς ἔδωκέν μοι κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπεσκέψατο ἐπ' ἐμὲ τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἶκον ἐν Ιερουσαλημ τῇ ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ

text_en: Who is there among you of all his people? His God be with him. Let him go up to Jerusalem , which is in Judea , and build the house of the Lord the God of Israel : he is the God that is in Jerusalem .
text_la: Quis est in vobis de universo populo ejus? Sit Deus illius cum ipso. Ascendat in Jerusalem, quæ est in Judæa, et ædificet domum Domini Dei Israël : ipse est Deus qui est in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Quem há entre vós, de todo o seu povo, seja seu Deus com ele, e suba a Jerusalém, que está em Judá, e edifique a casa do Senhor Deus de Israel (ele é o Deus) que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: τίς ἐν ὑμῖν ἀπὸ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναβήσεται εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τὴν ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ καὶ οἰκοδομησάτω τὸν οἶκον θεοῦ Ισραηλ αὐτὸς ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And let all the rest in all places wheresoever they dwell, help him every man from his place, with silver and gold, and goods, and cattle, besides that which they offer freely to the temple of God , which is in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et omnes reliqui in cunctis locis ubicumque habitant, adjuvent eum viri de loco suo argento et auro, et substantia, et pecoribus, excepto quod voluntarie offerunt templo Dei, quod est in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E todo aquele que ficar atrás em algum lugar em que andar peregrinando, os homens do seu lugar o ajudarão com prata, com ouro, com bens, e com gados, além das dádivas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ καταλειπόμενος ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν τόπων οὗ αὐτὸς παροικεῖ ἐκεῖ καὶ λήμψονται αὐτὸν ἄνδρες τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀργυρίῳ καὶ χρυσίῳ καὶ ἀποσκευῇ καὶ κτήνεσιν μετὰ τοῦ ἑκουσίου εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Juda and Benjamin , and the priests , and Levites , and every one whose spirit God had raised up, to go up to build the temple of the Lord , which was in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et surrexerunt principes patrum de Juda et Benjamin, et sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et omnis cujus Deus suscitavit spiritum, ut ascenderent ad ædificandum templum Domini, quod erat in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Então se levantaram os chefes dos pais de Judá e Benjamim, e os sacerdotes e os levitas, com todos aqueles cujo espírito Deus despertou, para subirem a edificar a casa do Senhor, que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῷ Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται πάντων ὧν ἐξήγειρεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῶν τοῦ ἀναβῆναι οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And all they that were round about, helped their hands with vessels of silver, and gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with furniture, besides what they had offered on their own accord.
text_la: Universique qui erant in circuitu, adjuverunt manus eorum in vasis argenteis et aureis, in substantia et jumentis, in supellectili, exceptis his quæ sponte obtulerant.
text_pt: E todos os que habitavam nos arredores lhes firmaram as mãos com vasos de prata, com ouro, com bens e com gado, e com coisas preciosas; além de tudo o que voluntariamente se deu.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ κυκλόθεν ἐνίσχυσαν ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν ἐν σκεύεσιν ἀργυρίου ἐν χρυσῷ ἐν ἀποσκευῇ καὶ ἐν κτήνεσιν καὶ ἐν ξενίοις πάρεξ τῶν ἐν ἑκουσίοις

text_en: And King Cyrus brought forth vessels of the temple of the Lord , which Nabuchodonosor had taken from Jerusalem , and had put them in the temple of his god.
text_la: Rex quoque Cyrus protulit vasa templi Domini, quæ tulerat Nabuchodonosor de Jerusalem, et posuerat ea in templo dei sui.
text_pt: Também o rei Ciro tirou os utensílios da casa do Senhor, que Nabucodonosor tinha trazido de Jerusalém, e que tinha posto na casa de seus deuses.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Κῦρος ἐξήνεγκεν τὰ σκεύη οἴκου κυρίου ἃ ἔλαβεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὰ ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now Cyrus king of Persia brought them forth by the hand of Mithridates the son of Gazabar, and numbered them to Sassabasar the prince of Juda .
text_la: Protulit autem ea Cyrus rex Persarum per manum Mithridatis filii Gazabar, et annumeravit ea Sassabasar principi Juda.
text_pt: Estes tirou Ciro, rei da Pérsia, pela mão de Mitredate, o tesoureiro, que os entregou contados a Sesbazar, príncipe de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὰ Κῦρος βασιλεὺς Περσῶν ἐπὶ χεῖρα Μιθραδάτου γασβαρηνου καὶ ἠρίθμησεν αὐτὰ τῷ Σασαβασαρ ἄρχοντι τοῦ Ιουδα

text_en: And this is the number of them: thirty bowls of gold, a thousand bowls of silver, nine and twenty knives, thirty cups of gold,
text_la: Et hic est numerus eorum : phialæ aureæ triginta, phialæ argenteæ mille, cultri viginti novem, scyphi aurei triginta,
text_pt: E este é o número deles: trinta travessas de ouro, mil travessas de prata, vinte e nove facas,
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ψυκτῆρες χρυσοῖ τριάκοντα καὶ ψυκτῆρες ἀργυροῖ χίλιοι παρηλλαγμένα ἐννέα καὶ εἴκοσι

text_en: silver cups of a second sort, four hundred and ten: other vessels a thousand.
text_la: scyphi argentei secundi quadringenti decem, vasa alia mille.
text_pt: Trinta bacias de ouro, mais outras quatrocentas e dez bacias de prata, e mil outros utensílios.
text_el: κεφφουρη χρυσοῖ τριάκοντα καὶ ἀργυροῖ διακόσιοι καὶ σκεύη ἕτερα χίλια

text_en: All the vessels of gold and silver, five thousand four hundred: all these Sassabasar brought with them that came up from the captivity of Babylon to Jerusalem .
text_la: Omnia vasa aurea et argentea quinque millia quadringenta: universa tulit Sassabasar cum his qui ascendebant de transmigratione Babylonis in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Todos os utensílios de ouro e de prata foram cinco mil e quatrocentos; todos estes levou Sesbazar, quando os do cativeiro subiram de babilônia para Jerusalém.
text_el: πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῷ χρυσῷ καὶ τῷ ἀργύρῳ πεντακισχίλια καὶ τετρακόσια τὰ πάντα ἀναβαίνοντα μετὰ Σασαβασαρ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀποικίας ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Now these are the children of the province, that went out of the captivity, which Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon , and who returned to Jerusalem and Juda , every man to his city.
text_la: Hi sunt autem provinciæ filii, qui ascenderunt de captivitate, quam transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis in Babylonem, et reversi sunt in Jerusalem et Judam, unusquisque in civitatem suam.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos da província, que subiram do cativeiro, dentre os exilados, que Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, tinha transportado a babilônia, e tornaram a Jerusalém e a Judá, cada um para a sua cidade;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς χώρας οἱ ἀναβαίνοντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας τῆς ἀποικίας ἧς ἀπῴκισεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ Ιουδα ἀνὴρ εἰς πόλιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who came with Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemia, Saraia, Rahelaia, Mardochai, Belsan, Mesphar, Beguai, Rehum, Baana. The number of the men of the people of Israel :
text_la: Qui venerunt cum Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemia, Saraia, Rahelaia, Mardochai, Belsan, Mesphar, Beguai, Rehum, Baana. Numerus virorum populi Israël:
text_pt: Os quais vieram com Zorobabel, Jesua, Neemias, Seraías, Reelaías, Mardoqueu, Bilsã, Mizpar, Bigvai, Reum e Baaná. O número dos homens do povo de Israel:
text_el: οἳ ἦλθον μετὰ Ζοροβαβελ Ἰησοῦς Νεεμιας Σαραιας Ρεελιας Μαρδοχαιος Βαλασαν Μασφαρ Βαγουι Ρεουμ Βαανα ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς λαοῦ Ισραηλ

text_la: filii Pharos duo millia centum septuaginta duo.
text_pt: Os filhos de Parós, dois mil cento e setenta e dois.
text_el: υἱοὶ Φορος δισχίλιοι ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα δύο

text_el: υἱοὶ τῶν πυλωρῶν υἱοὶ Σαλουμ υἱοὶ Ατηρ υἱοὶ Τελμων υἱοὶ Ακουβ υἱοὶ Ατιτα υἱοὶ Σαβαου οἱ πάντες ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἐννέα

text_en: The Nathinites : the children of Siha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
text_la: Nathinæi : filii Siha, filii Hasupha, filii Tabbaoth,
text_pt: Os netinins: os filhos de Zia, os filhos de Hasufa, os filhos de Tabaote,
text_el: οἱ ναθιναῖοι υἱοὶ Σουια υἱοὶ Ασουφε υἱοὶ Ταβαωθ

text_en: the children of Ceros, the children of Sia, the children of Phadon,
text_la: filii Ceros, filii Siaa, filii Phadon,
text_pt: Os filhos de Querós, os filhos de Siá, os filhos de Padom,
text_el: υἱοὶ Κηραος υἱοὶ Σωηα υἱοὶ Φαδων

text_en: the children of Lebana, the children of Hegaba, the children of Accub,
text_la: filii Lebana, filii Hagaba, filii Accub,
text_pt: Os filhos de Lebaná, os filhos de Hagaba, os filhos de Acube,
text_el: υἱοὶ Λαβανω υἱοὶ Αγαβα υἱοὶ Ακαβωθ

text_en: the children of Hagab, the children of Semlai, the children of Hanan,
text_la: filii Hagab, filii Semlai, filii Hanan,
text_pt: Os filhos de Hagabe, os filhos de Sanlai, os filhos de Hanã,
text_el: υἱοὶ Αγαβ υἱοὶ Σαμαλαι υἱοὶ Αναν

text_en: the children of Gaddel, the children of Gaher, the children of Raaia,
text_la: filii Gaddel, filii Gaher, filii Raaia,
text_pt: Os filhos de Gidel, os filhos de Gaar, os filhos de Reaías,
text_el: υἱοὶ Κεδελ υἱοὶ Γαερ υἱοὶ Ρεηα

text_en: the children of Rasin, the children of Necoda, the children of Gazam,
text_la: filii Rasin, filii Necoda, filii Gazam,
text_pt: Os filhos de Rezim, os filhos de Necoda, os filhos de Gazão,
text_el: υἱοὶ Ρασων υἱοὶ Νεκωδα υἱοὶ Γαζεμ

text_en: the children of Asa, the children of Phasea, the children of Besee,
text_la: filii Aza, filii Phasea, filii Besee,
text_pt: Os filhos de Uzá, os filhos de Paseá, os filhos de Besai,
text_el: υἱοὶ Ουσα υἱοὶ Φαση υἱοὶ Βασι

text_en: the children of Asena, the children of Munim, the children of Nephusim,
text_la: filii Asena, filii Munim, filii Nephusim,
text_pt: Os filhos de Asna, os filhos de Meunim, os filhos de Nefussim,
text_el: υἱοὶ Ασενα υἱοὶ Μαωνιμ υἱοὶ Ναφισων

text_en: the children of Bacbuc, the children of Hacupha, the children of Harhur,
text_la: filii Bacbuc, filii Hacupha, filii Harhur,
text_pt: Os filhos de Bacbuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βακβουκ υἱοὶ Ακιφα υἱοὶ Αρουρ

text_en: the children of Besluth, the children of Mahida, the children of Harsa,
text_la: filii Besluth, filii Mahida, filii Harsa,
text_pt: Os filhos de Bazlute, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βασαλωθ υἱοὶ Μαουδα υἱοὶ Αρησα

text_en: the children of Bercos, the children of Sisara, the children of Thema,
text_la: filii Bercos, filii Sisara, filii Thema,
text_pt: Os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Tama.
text_el: υἱοὶ Βαρκους υἱοὶ Σισαρα υἱοὶ Θεμα

text_en: the children of Nasia, the children of Hatipha,
text_la: filii Nasia, filii Hatipha,
text_pt: Os filhos de Neziá, os filhos de Hatifa.
text_el: υἱοὶ Νασουε υἱοὶ Ατουφα

text_en: the children of the servants of Solomon , the children of Sotai, the children of Sopheret, the children of Pharuda,
text_la: filii servorum Salomonis, filii Sotai, filii Sophereth, filii Pharuda,
text_pt: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão; os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Peruda,
text_el: υἱοὶ Αβδησελμα υἱοὶ Σατι υἱοὶ Ασεφηραθ υἱοὶ Φαδουρα

text_en: the children of Jala, the children of Dercon, the children of Geddel,
text_la: filii Jala, filii Dercon, filii Geddel,
text_pt: Os filhos de Jaalá, os filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel,
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιεηλα υἱοὶ Δαρκων υἱοὶ Γεδηλ

text_en: the children of Saphatia, the children of Hatil, the children of Phochereth, which were of Asebaim, the children of Ami,
text_la: filii Saphatia, filii Hatil, filii Phochereth, qui erant de Asebaim, filii Ami:
text_pt: Os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de PoquereteHazebaim, os filhos de Ami.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαφατια υἱοὶ Ατιλ υἱοὶ Φαχεραθ-ασεβωιν υἱοὶ Ημι

text_en: all the Nathinites , and the children of the servants of Solomon , three hundred ninety-two.
text_la: omnes Nathinæi, et filii servorum Salomonis, trecenti nonaginta duo.
text_pt: Todos os netinins, e os filhos dos servos de Salomão, trezentos e noventa e dois.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ναθινιν καὶ υἱοὶ Αβδησελμα τριακόσιοι ἐνενήκοντα δύο

text_en: And these are they that came up from Thelmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, and Adon, and Emer. And they could not show the house of their fathers and their seed, whether they were of Israel .
text_la: Et hi qui ascenderunt de Thelmala, Thelharsa, Cherub, et Adon, et Emer : et non potuerunt indicare domum patrum suorum et semen suum, utrum ex Israël essent.
text_pt: Também estes subiram de Tel-Melá e Tel-Harsa, Querube, Adã e Imer; porém não puderam provar que as suas famílias e a sua linhagem eram de Israel:
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἀναβάντες ἀπὸ Θελμελεθ Θελαρησα Χαρουβ Ηδαν Εμμηρ καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν τοῦ ἀναγγεῖλαι οἶκον πατριᾶς αὐτῶν καὶ σπέρμα αὐτῶν εἰ ἐξ Ισραηλ εἰσίν

text_en: The children of Dalaia, the children of Tobia, the children of Necoda, six hundred fifty-two.
text_la: Filii Dalaia, filii Tobia, filii Necoda, sexcenti quinquaginta duo.
text_pt: Os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e cinqüenta e dois.
text_el: υἱοὶ Δαλαια υἱοὶ Βουα υἱοὶ Τωβια υἱοὶ Νεκωδα ἑξακόσιοι πεντήκοντα δύο

text_en: And of the children of the priests : the children of Hobia, the children of Accos, the children of Berzellai, who took a wife of the daughters of Berzellai, the Galaadite, and was called by their name :
text_la: Et de filiis sacerdotum : filii Hobia, filii Accos, filii Berzellai, qui accepit de filiabus Berzellai Galaaditis, uxorem, et vocatus est nomine eorum:
text_pt: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomou mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e que foi chamado do seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων υἱοὶ Χαβια υἱοὶ Ακους υἱοὶ Βερζελλαι ὃς ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων Βερζελλαι τοῦ Γαλααδίτου γυναῖκα καὶ ἐκλήθη ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: These sought the writing of their genealogy, and found it not, and they were cast out of the priesthood .
text_la: hi quæsierunt scripturam genealogiæ suæ, et non invenerunt, et ejecti sunt de sacerdotio.
text_pt: Estes procuraram o seu registro entre os que estavam arrolados nas genealogias, mas não se acharam nelas; assim, por imundos, foram excluídos do sacerdócio.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐζήτησαν γραφὴν αὐτῶν οἱ μεθωεσιμ καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθησαν καὶ ἠγχιστεύθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἱερατείας

text_en: And Athersatha said to them, that they should not eat of the holy of holies, till there arose a priest learned and perfect.
text_la: Et dixit Athersatha eis ut non comederent de Sancto sanctorum, donec surgeret sacerdos doctus atque perfectus.
text_pt: E o governador lhes disse que não comessem das coisas consagradas, até que houvesse sacerdote com Urim e com Tumim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αθερσαθα αὐτοῖς τοῦ μὴ φαγεῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων ἕως ἀναστῇ ἱερεὺς τοῖς φωτίζουσιν καὶ τοῖς τελείοις

text_en: All the multitudes as one man , were forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty:
text_la: Omnis multitudo quasi unus, quadraginta duo millia trecenti sexaginta:
text_pt: Toda esta congregação junta foi de quarenta e dois mil trezentos e sessenta,
text_el: πᾶσα δὲ ἡ ἐκκλησία ὡς εἷς τέσσαρες μυριάδες δισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα

text_en: Besides their menservants, and womenservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven: and among them singing men , and singing women two hundred.
text_la: exceptis servis eorum, et ancillis, qui erant septem millia trecenti triginta septem : et in ipsis cantores atque cantatrices ducenti.
text_pt: Afora os seus servos e as suas servas, que foram sete mil trezentos e trinta e sete; também tinha duzentos cantores e cantoras.
text_el: χωρὶς δούλων αὐτῶν καὶ παιδισκῶν αὐτῶν οὗτοι ἑπτακισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι τριάκοντα ἑπτά καὶ οὗτοι ᾄδοντες καὶ ᾄδουσαι διακόσιοι

text_en: Their horses seven hundred thirty-six, their mules two hundred forty-five,
text_la: Equi eorum septingenti triginta sex, muli eorum, ducenti quadraginta quinque,
text_pt: Os seus cavalos, setecentos e trinta e seis; os seus mulos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco;
text_el: ἵπποι αὐτῶν ἑπτακόσιοι τριάκοντα ἕξ ἡμίονοι αὐτῶν διακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα πέντε

text_en: their camels four hundred thirty-five, their asses six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
text_la: cameli eorum, quadringenti triginta quinque, asini eorum, sex millia septingenti viginti.
text_pt: Os seus camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; os jumentos, seis mil setecentos e vinte.
text_el: κάμηλοι αὐτῶν τετρακόσιοι τριάκοντα πέντε ὄνοι αὐτῶν ἑξακισχίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι εἴκοσι

text_en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the temple of the Lord , which is in Jerusalem , offered freely to the house of the Lord to build it in its place.
text_la: Et de principibus patrum, cum ingrederentur templum Domini, quod est in Jerusalem, sponte obtulerunt in domum Dei ad exstruendam eam in loco suo.
text_pt: E alguns dos chefes dos pais, vindo à casa do Senhor, que habita em Jerusalém, deram ofertas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, para a estabelecerem no seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ ἀρχόντων πατριῶν ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον κυρίου τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἡκουσιάσαντο εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ στῆσαι αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: According to their ability, they gave towards the expenses of the work, sixty-one thousand solids of gold, five thousand pounds of silver, and a hundred garments for the priests .
text_la: Secundum vires suas dederunt impensas operis, auri solidos sexaginta millia et mille, argenti mnas quinque millia, et vestes sacerdotales centum.
text_pt: Conforme as suas posses, deram para o tesouro da obra, em ouro, sessenta e uma mil dracmas, e em prata cinco mil libras, e cem vestes sacerdotais.
text_el: ὡς ἡ δύναμις αὐτῶν ἔδωκαν εἰς θησαυρὸν τοῦ ἔργου χρυσίον καθαρόν μναῖ ἓξ μυριάδες καὶ χίλιαι καὶ ἀργύριον μναῖ πεντακισχίλιαι καὶ κοθωνοι τῶν ἱερέων ἑκατόν

text_en: So the priests and the Levites , and some of the people, and the singing men , and the porters, and the Nathinites dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
text_la: Habitaverunt ergo sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et de populo, et cantores, et janitores, et Nathinæi, in urbibus suis, universusque Israël in civitatibus suis.
text_pt: E habitaram os sacerdotes e os levitas, e alguns do povo, tanto os cantores, como os porteiros, e os netinins, nas suas cidades; como também todo o Israel nas suas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ναθινιμ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And now the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in their cities: and the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .
text_la: Jamque venerat mensis septimus, et erant filii Israël in civitatibus suis : congregatus est ergo populus quasi vir unus in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Chegando, pois, o sétimo mês, e estando os filhos de Israel já nas cidades, ajuntou-se o povo, como um só homem, em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔφθασεν ὁ μὴν ὁ ἕβδομος καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ συνήχθη ὁ λαὸς ὡς ἀνὴρ εἷς εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Josue the son of Josedec rose up, and his brethren the priests , and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his brethren, and they built the altar of the God of Israel that they might offer holocausts upon it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God .
text_la: Et surrexit Josue filius Josedec, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, et Zorobabel filius Salathiel, et fratres ejus, et ædificaverunt altare Dei Israël ut offerrent in eo holocautomata, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi viri Dei.
text_pt: E levantou-se Jesuá, filho de Jozadaque, e seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, e Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, e seus irmãos, e edificaram o altar do Deus de Israel, para oferecerem sobre ele holocaustos, como está escrito na lei de Moisés, o homem de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ιωσεδεκ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἱερεῖς καὶ Ζοροβαβελ ὁ τοῦ Σαλαθιηλ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὸ θυσιαστήριον θεοῦ Ισραηλ τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι ἐπ' αὐτὸ ὁλοκαυτώσεις κατὰ τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν νόμῳ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And they set the altar of God upon its bases, while the people of the lands round about put them in fear, and they offered upon it a holocaust to the Lord morning and evening.
text_la: Collocaverunt autem altare Dei super bases suas, deterrentibus eos per circuitum populis terrarum : et obtulerunt super illud holocaustum Domino mane et vespere.
text_pt: E firmaram o altar sobre as suas bases, porque o terror estava sobre eles, por causa dos povos das terras; e ofereceram sobre ele holocaustos ao Senhor, holocaustos pela manhã e à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐπὶ τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐν καταπλήξει ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν λαῶν τῶν γαιῶν καὶ ἀνέβη ἐπ' αὐτὸ ὁλοκαύτωσις τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ εἰς ἑσπέραν

text_en: And they kept the feast of tabernacles , as it is written, and offered the holocaust every day orderly according to the commandment, the duty of the day in its day.
text_la: Feceruntque solemnitatem tabernaculorum, sicut scriptum est, et holocaustum diebus singulis per ordinem secundum præceptum opus diei in die suo.
text_pt: E celebraram a festa dos tabernáculos, como está escrito; ofereceram holocaustos cada dia, por ordem, conforme ao rito, cada coisa em seu dia.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν σκηνῶν κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον καὶ ὁλοκαυτώσεις ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐν ἀριθμῷ ὡς ἡ κρίσις λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And afterwards the continual holocaust , both on the new moons, and on all the solemnities of the Lord , that were consecrated , and on all in which a freewill offering was made to the Lord .
text_la: Et post hæc holocaustum juge, tam in calendis quam in universis solemnitatibus Domini quæ erant consecratæ, et in omnibus in quibus ultro offerebatur munus Domino.
text_pt: E depois disto o holocausto contínuo, e os das luas novas e de todas as solenidades consagradas ao Senhor; como também de qualquer que oferecia oferta voluntária ao Senhor;
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ὁλοκαυτώσεις ἐνδελεχισμοῦ καὶ εἰς τὰς νουμηνίας καὶ εἰς πάσας ἑορτὰς τὰς ἡγιασμένας καὶ παντὶ ἑκουσιαζομένῳ ἑκούσιον τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer holocausts to the Lord : but the temple of God was not yet founded.
text_la: A primo die mensis septimi cœperunt offerre holocaustum Domino : porro templum Dei nondum fundatum erat.
text_pt: Desde o primeiro dia do sétimo mês começaram a oferecer holocaustos ao SENHOR; porém ainda não estavam postos os fundamentos do templo do SENHOR.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου ἤρξαντο ἀναφέρειν ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ὁ οἶκος κυρίου οὐκ ἐθεμελιώθη

text_en: And they gave money to hewers of stones and to masons: and meat and drink, and oil to the Sidonians and Tyrians, to bring cedar trees from Libanus to the sea of Joppe , according to the orders which Cyrus king of the Persians had given them.
text_la: Dederunt autem pecunias latomis et cæmentariis : cibum quoque, et potum, et oleum Sidoniis Tyriisque, ut deferrent ligna cedrina de Libano ad mare Joppe, juxta quod præceperat Cyrus rex Persarum eis.
text_pt: Deram, pois, o dinheiro aos pedreiros e carpinteiros, como também comida e bebida, e azeite aos sidônios, e aos tírios, para trazerem do Líbano madeira de cedro ao mar, para Jope, segundo a concessão que lhes tinha feito Ciro, rei da Pérsia.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν ἀργύριον τοῖς λατόμοις καὶ τοῖς τέκτοσιν καὶ βρώματα καὶ ποτὰ καὶ ἔλαιον τοῖς Σηδανιν καὶ τοῖς Σωριν ἐνέγκαι ξύλα κέδρινα ἀπὸ τοῦ Λιβάνου πρὸς θάλασσαν Ιόππης κατ' ἐπιχώρησιν Κύρου βασιλέως Περσῶν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And in the second year of their coming to the temple of God in Jerusalem , the second month, Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Josue the son of Josedec, and the rest of their brethren the priests , and the Levites , and all that had come from the captivity to Jerusalem began, and they appointed Levites from twenty years old and upward, to hasten forward the work of the Lord .
text_la: Anno autem secundo adventus eorum ad templum Dei in Jerusalem, mense secundo, cœperunt Zorobabel filius Salathiel, et Josue filius Josedec, et reliqui de fratribus eorum sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et omnes qui venerant de captivitate in Jerusalem, et constituerunt Levitas a viginti annis et supra, ut urgerent opus Domini.
text_pt: E no segundo ano da sua vinda à casa de Deus em Jerusalém, no segundo mês, Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, e Jesuá, filho de Jozadaque, e os outros seus irmãos, os sacerdotes e os levitas, e todos os que vieram do cativeiro a Jerusalém, começaram a obra da casa do Senhor, e constituíram os levitas da idade de vinte anos para cima, para que a dirigissem.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἤρξατο Ζοροβαβελ ὁ τοῦ Σαλαθιηλ καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ιωσεδεκ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐρχόμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔστησαν τοὺς Λευίτας ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰ ἔργα ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: Then Josue and his sons and his brethren, Cedmihel, and his sons, and the children of Juda , as one man , stood to hasten them that did the work in the temple of God : the sons of Henadad, and their sons, and their brethren the Levites .
text_la: Stetitque Josue et filii ejus et fratres ejus, Cedmihel et filii ejus, et filii Juda, quasi vir unus, ut instarent super eos qui faciebant opus in templo Dei : filii Henadad, et filii eorum, et fratres eorum Levitæ.
text_pt: Então se levantou Jesuá, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, Cadmiel e seus filhos, os filhos de Judá, como um só homem, para dirigirem os que faziam a obra na casa de Deus, bem como os filhos de Henadade, seus filhos e seus irmãos, os levitas.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Καδμιηλ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ἐπὶ τοὺς ποιοῦντας τὰ ἔργα ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ υἱοὶ Ηναδαδ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ Λευῖται

text_en: And when the masons laid the foundations of the temple of the Lord , the priests stood in their ornaments with trumpets: and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise God by the hands of David king of Israel .
text_la: Fundato igitur a cæmentariis templo Domini, steterunt sacerdotes in ornatu suo cum tubis, et Levitæ filii Asaph in cymbalis, ut laudarent Deum per manus David regis Israël.
text_pt: Quando, pois, os edificadores lançaram os alicerces do templo do Senhor, então apresentaram-se os sacerdotes, já vestidos e com trombetas, e os levitas, filhos de Asafe, com címbalos, para louvarem ao Senhor conforme à instituição de Davi, rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐθεμελίωσαν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον κυρίου καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐστολισμένοι ἐν σάλπιγξιν καὶ οἱ Λευῖται υἱοὶ Ασαφ ἐν κυμβάλοις τοῦ αἰνεῖν τὸν κύριον ἐπὶ χεῖρας Δαυιδ βασιλέως Ισραηλ

text_en: And they sung together hymns, and praise to the Lord : because he is good , for his mercy endures for ever towards Israel . And all the people shouted with a great shout, praising the Lord , because the foundations of the temple of the Lord were laid.
text_la: Et concinebant in hymnis, et confessione Domino : Quoniam bonus, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus super Israël. Omnis quoque populus vociferabatur clamore magno in laudando Dominum, eo quod fundatum esset templum Domini.
text_pt: E cantavam juntos por grupo, louvando e rendendo graças ao Senhor, dizendo: porque é bom; porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre sobre Israel. E todo o povo jubilou com altas vozes, quando louvaram ao Senhor, pela fundação da casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν ἐν αἴνῳ καὶ ἀνθομολογήσει τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι ἀγαθόν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐσήμαινον φωνὴν μεγάλην αἰνεῖν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπὶ θεμελιώσει οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: But many of the priests and the Levites , and the chief of the fathers and the ancients that had seen the former temple ; when they had the foundation of this temple before their eyes, wept with a loud voice: and many shouting for joy , lifted up their voice.
text_la: Plurimi etiam de sacerdotibus et Levitis, et principes patrum, et seniores, qui viderant templum prius cum fundatum esset, et hoc templum, in oculis eorum, flebant voce magna : et multi vociferantes in lætitia, elevabant vocem.
text_pt: Porém muitos dos sacerdotes, e levitas e chefes dos pais, já idosos, que viram a primeira casa, choraram em altas vozes quando à sua vista foram lançados os fundamentos desta casa; mas muitos levantaram as vozes com júbilo e com alegria.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν καὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι οἳ εἴδοσαν τὸν οἶκον τὸν πρῶτον ἐν θεμελιώσει αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦτον τὸν οἶκον ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν ἔκλαιον φωνῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ὄχλος ἐν σημασίᾳ μετ' εὐφροσύνης τοῦ ὑψῶσαι ᾠδήν

text_en: So that one could not distinguish the voice of the shout of joy , from the noise of the weeping of the people: for one with another the people shouted with a loud shout, and the voice was heard afar off.
text_la: Nec poterat quisquam agnoscere vocem clamoris lætantium, et vocem fletus populi : commistim enim populus vociferabatur clamore magno, et vox audiebatur procul.
text_pt: De maneira que não discernia o povo as vozes do júbilo de alegria das vozes do choro do povo; porque o povo jubilava com tão altas vozes, que o som se ouvia de muito longe.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ λαὸς ἐπιγινώσκων φωνὴν σημασίας τῆς εὐφροσύνης ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ κλαυθμοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ ὅτι ὁ λαὸς ἐκραύγασεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἠκούετο ἕως ἀπὸ μακρόθεν

text_en: Now the enemies of Juda and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Audierunt autem hostes Judæ et Benjamin, quia filii captivitatis ædificarent templum Domino Deo Israël:
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, os adversários de Judá e Benjamim que os que voltaram do cativeiro edificavam o templo ao SENHOR Deus de Israel,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ θλίβοντες Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν ὅτι οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς ἀποικίας οἰκοδομοῦσιν οἶκον τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And they came to Zorobabel, and the chief of the fathers, and said to them: Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do: behold we have sacrificed to him, since the days of Asor Haddan king of Assyria , who brought us hither.
text_la: et accedentes ad Zorobabel, et ad principes patrum, dixerunt eis : Ædificemus vobiscum, quia ita ut vos, quærimus Deum vestrum : ecce nos immolavimus victimas a diebus Asor Haddan regis Assur, qui adduxit nos huc.
text_pt: Chegaram-se a Zorobabel e aos chefes dos pais, e disseram-lhes: Deixai-nos edificar convosco, porque, como vós, buscaremos a vosso Deus; como também já lhe sacrificamos desde os dias de Esar-Hadom, rei da Assíria, que nos fez subir aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισαν πρὸς Ζοροβαβελ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν πατριῶν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς οἰκοδομήσομεν μεθ' ὑμῶν ὅτι ὡς ὑμεῖς ἐκζητοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν καὶ αὐτῷ ἡμεῖς θυσιάζομεν ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν Ασαραδδων βασιλέως Ασσουρ τοῦ ἐνέγκαντος ἡμᾶς ὧδε

text_en: But Zorobabel, and Josue, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel said to them: You have nothing to do with us to build a house to our God , but we ourselves alone will build to the Lord our God , as Cyrus king of the Persians has commanded us.
text_la: Et dixit eis Zorobabel, et Josue, et reliqui principes patrum Israël : Non est vobis et nobis ut ædificemus domum Deo nostro, sed nos ipsi soli ædificabimus Domino Deo nostro, sicut præcepit nobis Cyrus rex Persarum.
text_pt: Porém Zorobabel, e Jesuá, e os outros chefes dos pais de Israel lhes disseram: Não convém que nós e vós edifiquemos casa a nosso Deus; mas nós sozinhos a edificaremos ao Senhor Deus de Israel, como nos ordenou o rei Ciro, rei da Pérsia.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ζοροβαβελ καὶ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν πατριῶν τοῦ Ισραηλ οὐχ ἡμῖν καὶ ὑμῖν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ὅτι ἡμεῖς αὐτοὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ οἰκοδομήσομεν τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν ὡς ἐνετείλατο ἡμῖν Κῦρος ὁ βασιλεὺς Περσῶν

text_en: Then the people of the land hindered the hands of the people of Juda , and troubled them in building.
text_la: Factum est igitur ut populus terræ impediret manus populi Judæ, et turbaret eos in ædificando.
text_pt: Todavia o povo da terra debilitava as mãos do povo de Judá, e inquietava-os no edificar.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς τῆς γῆς ἐκλύων τὰς χεῖρας τοῦ λαοῦ Ιουδα καὶ ἐνεπόδιζον αὐτοὺς τοῦ οἰκοδομεῖν

text_en: And they hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their design all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
text_la: Conduxerunt autem adversus eos consiliatores, ut destruerent consilium eorum omnibus diebus Cyri regis Persarum, et usque ad regnum Darii regis Persarum.
text_pt: E alugaram contra eles conselheiros, para frustrarem o seu plano, todos os dias de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, até ao reinado de Dario, rei da Pérsia.
text_el: καὶ μισθούμενοι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς βουλευόμενοι τοῦ διασκεδάσαι βουλὴν αὐτῶν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας Κύρου βασιλέως Περσῶν καὶ ἕως βασιλείας Δαρείου βασιλέως Περσῶν

text_en: And in the reign of Assuerus , in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Juda and Jerusalem .
text_la: In regno autem Assueri, in principio regni ejus, scripserunt accusationem adversus habitatores Judæ et Jerusalem.
text_pt: No reinado de Assuero, no princípio do seu reinado, escreveram uma acusação contra os habitantes de Judá e de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐν βασιλείᾳ Ασουηρου ἐν ἀρχῇ βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἔγραψαν ἐπιστολὴν ἐπὶ οἰκοῦντας Ιουδα καὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And in the days of Artaxerxes , Beselam , Mithridates, and Thabeel, and the rest that were in the council wrote to Artaxerxes king of the Persians: and the letter of accusation was written in Syrian , and was read in the Syrian tongue.
text_la: Et in diebus Artaxerxis scripsit Beselam, Mithridates, et Thabeel, et reliqui qui erant in consilio eorum, ad Artaxerxem regem Persarum : epistola autem accusationis scripta erat syriace, et legebatur sermone syro.
text_pt: E nos dias de Artaxerxes escreveram Bislão, Mitredate, Tabeel, e os outros seus companheiros, a Artaxerxes, rei da Pérsia; e a carta estava escrita em caracteres siríacos, e na língua siríaca.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Αρθασασθα ἔγραψεν ἐν εἰρήνῃ Μιθραδάτῃ Ταβεηλ σὺν καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς συνδούλοις αὐτοῦ πρὸς Αρθασασθα βασιλέα Περσῶν ἔγραψεν ὁ φορολόγος γραφὴν Συριστὶ καὶ ἡρμηνευμένην

text_en: Reum Beelteem, and Samsai the scribe wrote a letter from Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes, in this manner:
text_la: Reum Beelteem, et Samsai scriba, scripserunt epistolam unam de Jerusalem Artaxerxi regi, hujuscemodi:
text_pt: Escreveram, pois, Reum, o chanceler, e Sinsai, o escrivão, uma carta contra Jerusalém, ao rei Artaxerxes, do teor seguinte:
text_el: Ραουμ βααλταμ καὶ Σαμσαι ὁ γραμματεὺς ἔγραψαν ἐπιστολὴν μίαν κατὰ Ιερουσαλημ τῷ Αρθασασθα βασιλεῖ

text_en: Reum Beelteem, and Samsai the scribe and the rest of their counsellors, the Dinites, and the Apharsathacites, the Therphalites, the Apharsites, the Erchuites, the Babylonians , the Susanechites, the Dievites, and the Elamites,
text_la: Reum Beelteem, et Samsai scriba, et reliqui consiliatores eorum, Dinæi, et Apharsathachæi, Terphalæi, Apharsæi, Erchuæi, Babylonii, Susanechæi, Dievi, et Ælamitæ,
text_pt: Então escreveu Reum, o chanceler, e Sinsai, o escrivão, e os outros seus companheiros, os dinaítas, afarsaquitas, tarpelitas, afarsitas, arquevitas, babilônios, susanquitas, deavitas, elamitas,
text_el: τάδε ἔκρινεν Ραουμ βααλταμ καὶ Σαμσαι ὁ γραμματεὺς καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι σύνδουλοι ἡμῶν Διναῖοι Αφαρσαθαχαῖοι Ταρφαλλαῖοι Αφαρσαῖοι Αρχυαῖοι Βαβυλώνιοι Σουσαναχαῖοι οἵ εἰσιν Ηλαμαῖοι

text_en: and the rest of the nations, whom the great and glorious Asenaphar brought over: and made to dwell in the cities of Samaria and in the rest of the countries of this side of the river in peace.
text_la: et ceteri de gentibus, quas transtulit Asenaphar magnus et gloriosus, et habitare eas fecit in civitatibus Samariæ, et in reliquis regionibus trans flumen in pace
text_pt: E os outros povos, que o grande e afamado Asnapar transportou, e que fez habitar na cidade de Samaria, e nas demais províncias dalém do rio, em tal tempo.
text_el: καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι ἐθνῶν ὧν ἀπῴκισεν Ασενναφαρ ὁ μέγας καὶ ὁ τίμιος καὶ κατῴκισεν αὐτοὺς ἐν πόλεσιν τῆς Σομορων καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: (This is the copy of the letter , which they sent to him): To Artaxerxes the king, your servants, the men that are on this side of the river, send greeting.
text_la: (hoc est exemplar epistolæ, quam miserunt ad eum), Artaxerxi regi, servi tui, viri qui sunt trans fluvium, salutem dicunt.
text_pt: Este, pois, é o teor da carta que mandaram ao rei Artaxerxes: Teus servos, os homens dalém do rio, em tal tempo.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ διαταγὴ τῆς ἐπιστολῆς ἧς ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτόν πρὸς Αρθασασθα βασιλέα παῖδές σου ἄνδρες πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: Be it known to the king, that the Jews , who came up from you to us, have come to Jerusalem a rebellious and wicked city, which they are building, setting up the ramparts thereof and repairing the walls.
text_la: Notum sit regi quia Judæi, qui ascenderunt a te ad nos, venerunt in Jerusalem civitatem rebellem et pessimam, quam ædificant exstruentes muros ejus, et parietes componentes.
text_pt: Saiba o rei que os judeus, que subiram de ti, vieram a nós em Jerusalém, e reedificam aquela rebelde e malvada cidade, e vão restaurando os seus muros, e reparando os seus fundamentos.
text_el: γνωστὸν ἔστω τῷ βασιλεῖ ὅτι οἱ Ιουδαῖοι ἀναβάντες ἀπὸ σοῦ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἀποστάτιν καὶ πονηρὰν οἰκοδομοῦσιν καὶ τὰ τείχη αὐτῆς κατηρτισμένοι εἰσίν καὶ θεμελίους αὐτῆς ἀνύψωσαν

text_en: And now be it known to the king, that if this city be built up, and the walls thereof repaired, they will not pay tribute nor toll, nor yearly revenues, and this loss will fall upon the kings.
text_la: Nunc igitur notum sit regi, quia si civitas illa ædificata fuerit, et muri ejus instaurati, tributum, et vectigal, et annuos reditus non dabunt, et usque ad reges hæc noxa perveniet.
text_pt: Agora saiba o rei que, se aquela cidade se reedificar, e os muros se restaurarem, eles não pagarão os direitos, os tributos e os pedágios; e assim se danificará a fazenda dos reis.
text_el: νῦν οὖν γνωστὸν ἔστω τῷ βασιλεῖ ὅτι ἐὰν ἡ πόλις ἐκείνη ἀνοικοδομηθῇ καὶ τὰ τείχη αὐτῆς καταρτισθῶσιν φόροι οὐκ ἔσονταί σοι οὐδὲ δώσουσιν καὶ τοῦτο βασιλεῖς κακοποιεῖ

text_en: But we remembering the salt that we have eaten in the palace, and because we count it a crime to see the king wronged, have therefore sent and certified the king,
text_la: Nos autem memores salis, quod in palatio comedimus, et quia læsiones regis videre nefas ducimus, idcirco misimus et nuntiavimus regi,
text_pt: Agora, pois, porquanto somos assalariados do palácio, e não nos convém ver a desonra do rei, por isso mandamos avisar ao rei,
text_el: καὶ ἀσχημοσύνην βασιλέως οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἡμῖν ἰδεῖν διὰ τοῦτο ἐπέμψαμεν καὶ ἐγνωρίσαμεν τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: that search may be made in the books of the histories of your fathers, and you shall find written in the records: and shall know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to the kings and provinces, and that wars were raised therein of old time: for which cause also the city was destroyed.
text_la: ut recenseas in libris historiarum patrum tuorum, et invenies scriptum in commentariis : et scies quoniam urbs illa, urbs rebellis est, et nocens regibus et provinciis, et bella concitantur in ea ex diebus antiquis : quam ob rem et civitas ipsa destructa est.
text_pt: Para que se busque no livro das crônicas de teus pais. E acharás no livro das crônicas, e saberás que aquela foi uma cidade rebelde, e danosa aos reis e províncias, e que nela houve rebelião em tempos antigos; por isso foi aquela cidade destruída.
text_el: ἵνα ἐπισκέψηται ἐν βιβλίῳ ὑπομνηματισμοῦ τῶν πατέρων σου καὶ εὑρήσεις καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἡ πόλις ἐκείνη πόλις ἀποστάτις καὶ κακοποιοῦσα βασιλεῖς καὶ χώρας καὶ φυγάδια δούλων ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἀπὸ χρόνων αἰῶνος διὰ ταῦτα ἡ πόλις αὕτη ἠρημώθη

text_en: We certify the king, that if this city be built, and the walls thereof repaired, you shall have no possession on this side of the river.
text_la: Nuntiamus nos regi, quoniam si civitas illa ædificata fuerit, et muri ipsius instaurati, possessionem trans fluvium non habebis.
text_pt: Nós, pois, fazemos notório ao rei que, se aquela cidade se reedificar, e os seus muros se restaurarem, sucederá que não terás porção alguma deste lado do rio.
text_el: γνωρίζομεν οὖν ἡμεῖς τῷ βασιλεῖ ὅτι ἐὰν ἡ πόλις ἐκείνη οἰκοδομηθῇ καὶ τὰ τείχη αὐτῆς καταρτισθῇ οὐκ ἔστιν σοι εἰρήνη

text_en: The king sent word to Reum Beelteem and Samsai the scribe , and to the rest that were in their council, inhabitants of Samaria , and to the rest beyond the river, sending greeting and peace.
text_la: Verbum misit rex ad Reum Beelteem, et Samsai scribam, et ad reliquos, qui erant in consilio eorum habitatores Samariæ, et ceteris trans fluvium, salutem dicens et pacem.
text_pt: E o rei enviou esta resposta a Reum, o chanceler, e a Sinsai, o escrivão, e aos demais seus companheiros, que habitavam em Samaria; como também aos demais que estavam dalém do rio: Paz! em tal tempo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Ραουμ βααλταμ καὶ Σαμσαι γραμματέα καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους συνδούλους αὐτῶν τοὺς οἰκοῦντας ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ τοὺς καταλοίπους πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ εἰρήνην καί φησιν

text_en: The accusation, which you have sent to us, has been plainly read before me,
text_la: Accusatio, quam misistis ad nos, manifeste lecta est coram me,
text_pt: A carta que nos enviastes foi explicitamente lida diante de mim.
text_el: ὁ φορολόγος ὃν ἀπεστείλατε πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἐκλήθη ἔμπροσθεν ἐμοῦ

text_en: and I commanded: and search has been made, and it is found, that this city of old time has rebelled against kings, and seditions and wars have been raised therein.
text_la: et a me præceptum est : et recensuerunt, inveneruntque quoniam civitas illa a diebus antiquis adversum reges rebellat, et seditiones, et prælia concitantur in ea:
text_pt: E, ordenando-o eu, buscaram e acharam, que de tempos antigos aquela cidade se levantou contra os reis, e nela se têm feito rebelião e sedição.
text_el: καὶ παρ' ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη καὶ ἐπεσκεψάμεθα καὶ εὕραμεν ὅτι ἡ πόλις ἐκείνη ἀφ' ἡμερῶν αἰῶνος ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς ἐπαίρεται καὶ ἀποστάσεις καὶ φυγάδια γίνονται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: For there have been powerful kings in Jerusalem , who have had dominion over all the country that is beyond the river: and have received tribute, and toll and revenues.
text_la: nam et reges fortissimi fuerunt in Jerusalem, qui et dominati sunt omni regioni quæ trans fluvium est : tributum quoque et vectigal, et reditus accipiebant.
text_pt: Também houve reis poderosos sobre Jerusalém que dalém do rio dominaram em todo o lugar, e se lhes pagaram direitos, tributos e pedágios.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεῖς ἰσχυροὶ γίνονται ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπικρατοῦντες ὅλης τῆς ἑσπέρας τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ φόροι πλήρεις καὶ μέρος δίδοται αὐτοῖς

text_en: Now therefore hear the sentence: Hinder those men , that this city be not built, till further orders be given by me.
text_la: Nunc ergo audite sententiam : prohibeatis viros illos, ut urbs illa non ædificetur donec si forte a me jussum fuerit.
text_pt: Agora, pois, dai ordem para impedirdes aqueles homens, a fim de que não se edifique aquela cidade, até que eu dê uma ordem.
text_el: καὶ νῦν θέτε γνώμην καταργῆσαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐκείνους καὶ ἡ πόλις ἐκείνη οὐκ οἰκοδομηθήσεται ἔτι ὅπως ἀπὸ τῆς γνώμης

text_en: See that you be not negligent in executing this, lest by little and little the evil grow to the hurt of the kings.
text_la: Videte ne negligenter hoc impleatis, et paulatim crescat malum contra reges.
text_pt: E guardai-vos de serdes remissos nisto; por que cresceria o dano para prejuízo dos reis?
text_el: πεφυλαγμένοι ἦτε ἄνεσιν ποιῆσαι περὶ τούτου μήποτε πληθυνθῇ ἀφανισμὸς εἰς κακοποίησιν βασιλεῦσιν

text_en: Now the copy of the edict of King Artaxerxes was read before Reum Beelteem, and Samsai the scribe , and their counsellors: and they went up in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews , and hindered them with arm and power.
text_la: Itaque exemplum edicti Artaxerxis regis lectum est coram Reum Beelteem, et Samsai scriba, et consiliariis eorum : et abierunt festini in Jerusalem ad Judæos, et prohibuerunt eos in brachio et robore.
text_pt: Então, depois que a cópia da carta do rei Artaxerxes foi lida perante Reum, e Sinsai, o escrivão, e seus companheiros, apressadamente foram eles a Jerusalém, aos judeus, e os impediram à força e com violência.
text_el: τότε ὁ φορολόγος τοῦ Αρθασασθα βασιλέως ἀνέγνω ἐνώπιον Ραουμ καὶ Σαμσαι γραμματέως καὶ συνδούλων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν σπουδῇ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐν Ιουδα καὶ κατήργησαν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἵπποις καὶ δυνάμει

text_en: Then the work of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem was interrupted, and ceased till the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
text_la: Tunc intermissum est opus domus Domini in Jerusalem, et non fiebat usque ad annum secundum regni Darii regis Persarum.
text_pt: Então cessou a obra da casa de Deus, que estava em Jerusalém; e cessou até ao ano segundo do reinado de Dario, rei da Pérsia.
text_el: τότε ἤργησεν τὸ ἔργον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἦν ἀργοῦν ἕως δευτέρου ἔτους τῆς βασιλείας Δαρείου τοῦ βασιλέως Περσῶν

text_en: Now Aggeus the prophet , and Zacharias the son of Addo, prophesied to the Jews that were in Judea and Jerusalem , in the name of the God of Israel .
text_la: Prophetaverunt autem Aggæus propheta, et Zacharias filius Addo, prophetantes ad Judæos qui erant in Judæa et Jerusalem, in nomine Dei Israël.
text_pt: E os profetas Ageu e Zacarias, filho de Ido, profetizaram aos judeus que estavam em Judá, e em Jerusalém; em nome do Deus de Israel lhes profetizaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν Αγγαιος ὁ προφήτης καὶ Ζαχαριας ὁ τοῦ Αδδω προφητείαν ἐπὶ τοὺς Ιουδαίους τοὺς ἐν Ιουδα καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ὀνόματι θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: Then rose up Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Josue the son of Josedec, and began to build the temple of God in Jerusalem , and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
text_la: Tunc surrexerunt Zorobabel filius Salathiel, et Josue filius Josedec, et cœperunt ædificare templum Dei in Jerusalem, et cum eis prophetæ Dei adjuvantes eos.
text_pt: Então se levantaram Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, e Jesuá, filho de Jozadaque, e começaram a edificar a casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém; e com eles os profetas de Deus, que os ajudavam.
text_el: τότε ἀνέστησαν Ζοροβαβελ ὁ τοῦ Σαλαθιηλ καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ υἱὸς Ιωσεδεκ καὶ ἤρξαντο οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν οἱ προφῆται τοῦ θεοῦ βοηθοῦντες αὐτοῖς

text_en: And at the same time came to them Thathanai, who was governor beyond the river, and Stharbuzanai, and their counsellors: and said thus to them: Who has given you counsel to build this house, and to repair the walls thereof?
text_la: In ipso autem tempore venit ad eos Thathanai, qui erat dux trans flumen, et Stharbuzanai, et consiliarii eorum : sicque dixerunt eis : Quis dedit vobis consilium ut domum hanc ædificaretis, et muros ejus instauraretis?
text_pt: Naquele tempo vieram a eles Tatenai, governador dalém do rio, e Setar-Bozenai, e os seus companheiros, e disseram-lhes assim: Quem vos deu ordem para reedificardes esta casa, e restaurardes este muro?
text_el: ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ ἦλθεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς Θανθαναι ἔπαρχος πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ Σαθαρβουζανα καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν καὶ τοῖα εἶπαν αὐτοῖς τίς ἔθηκεν ὑμῖν γνώμην τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ τὴν χορηγίαν ταύτην καταρτίσασθαι

text_en: In answer to which we gave them the names of the men who were the promoters of that building.
text_la: Ad quod respondimus eis, quæ essent nomina hominum auctorum ædificationis illius.
text_pt: Disseram-lhes, mais: E quais são os nomes dos homens que construíram este edifício?
text_el: τότε ταῦτα εἴποσαν αὐτοῖς τίνα ἐστὶν τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν οἰκοδομούντων τὴν πόλιν ταύτην

text_en: But the eye of their God was upon the ancients of the Jews , and they could not hinder them. And it was agreed that the matter should be referred to Darius, and then they should give satisfaction concerning that accusation.
text_la: Oculus autem Dei eorum factus est super senes Judæorum, et non potuerunt inhibere eos. Placuitque ut res ad Darium referretur, et tunc satisfacerent adversus accusationem illam.
text_pt: Porém os olhos de Deus estavam sobre os anciãos dos judeus, e não os impediram, até que o negócio chegasse a Dario, e viesse resposta por carta sobre isso.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ιουδα καὶ οὐ κατήργησαν αὐτούς ἕως γνώμη τῷ Δαρείῳ ἀπηνέχθη καὶ τότε ἀπεστάλη τῷ φορολόγῳ ὑπὲρ τούτου

text_en: The copy of the letter that Thathanai governor of the country beyond the river, and Stharbuzanai, and his counsellors the Arphasachites, who dwelt beyond the river, sent to Darius the king.
text_la: Exemplar epistolæ, quam misit Thathanai dux regionis trans flumen, et Stharbuzanai, et consiliatores ejus Arphasachæi, qui erant trans flumen, ad Darium regem.
text_pt: Cópia da carta que Tatenai, o governador dalém do rio, com Setar-Bozenai e os seus companheiros, os afarsaquitas, que estavam dalém do rio, enviaram ao rei Dario.
text_el: διασάφησις ἐπιστολῆς ἧς ἀπέστειλεν Θανθαναι ὁ ἔπαρχος τοῦ πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ Σαθαρβουζανα καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν Αφαρσαχαῖοι οἱ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ Δαρείῳ τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: The letter which they sent him, was written thus: To Darius the king all peace.
text_la: Sermo, quem miserant ei, sic scriptus erat : Dario regi pax omnis.
text_pt: Enviaram-lhe uma carta, na qual estava escrito: Toda a paz ao rei Dario.
text_el: ῥῆσιν ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ τάδε γέγραπται ἐν αὐτῷ Δαρείῳ τῷ βασιλεῖ εἰρήνη πᾶσα

text_en: Be it known to the king, that we went to the province of Judea , to the house of the great God , which they are building with unpolished stones, and timber is laid in the walls: and this work is carried on diligently and advances in their hands.
text_la: Notum sit regi, isse nos ad Judæam provinciam, ad domum Dei magni, quæ ædificatur lapide impolito, et ligna ponuntur in parietibus : opusque illud diligenter exstruitur, et crescit in manibus eorum.
text_pt: Seja notório ao rei, que nós fomos à província de Judá, à casa do grande Deus, a qual se edifica com grandes pedras, e a madeira já está sendo posta nas paredes; e esta obra vai sendo feita com diligência, e se adianta em suas mãos.
text_el: γνωστὸν ἔστω τῷ βασιλεῖ ὅτι ἐπορεύθημεν εἰς τὴν Ιουδαίαν χώραν εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου καὶ αὐτὸς οἰκοδομεῖται λίθοις ἐκλεκτοῖς καὶ ξύλα ἐντίθεται ἐν τοῖς τοίχοις καὶ τὸ ἔργον ἐκεῖνο ἐπιδέξιον γίνεται καὶ εὐοδοῦται ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And we asked those ancients, and said to them thus: Who has given you authority to build this house, and to repair these walls?
text_la: Interrogavimus ergo senes illos, et ita diximus eis : Quis dedit vobis potestatem ut domum hanc ædificaretis, et muros hos instauraretis?
text_pt: Então perguntamos aos anciãos, e assim lhes dissemos: Quem vos deu ordem para reedificardes esta casa, e restaurardes este muro?
text_el: τότε ἠρωτήσαμεν τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους ἐκείνους καὶ οὕτως εἴπαμεν αὐτοῖς τίς ἔθηκεν ὑμῖν γνώμην τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον οἰκοδομῆσαι καὶ τὴν χορηγίαν ταύτην καταρτίσασθαι

text_en: We asked also of them their names , that we might give you notice: and we have written the names of the men that are the chief among them.
text_la: Sed et nomina eorum quæsivimus ab eis, ut nuntiaremus tibi : scripsimusque nomina eorum virorum, qui sunt principes in eis.
text_pt: Além disso, lhes perguntamos também pelos seus nomes, para tos declararmos; para que te pudéssemos escrever os nomes dos homens que entre eles são os chefes.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν ἠρωτήσαμεν αὐτοὺς γνωρίσαι σοι ὥστε γράψαι σοι τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτῶν

text_en: And they answered us in these words, saying: We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building a temple that was built these many years ago, and which a great king of Israel built and set up.
text_la: Hujuscemodi autem sermonem responderunt nobis dicentes : Nos sumus servi Dei cæli et terræ, et ædificamus templum, quod erat exstructum ante hos annos multos, quodque rex Israël magnus ædificaverat, et exstruxerat.
text_pt: E esta foi a resposta que nos deram: Nós somos servos do Deus dos céus e da terra, e reedificamos a casa que há muitos anos foi edificada; porque um grande rei de Israel a edificou e a terminou.
text_el: καὶ τοιοῦτο ῥῆμα ἀπεκρίθησαν ἡμῖν λέγοντες ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν δοῦλοι τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ οἰκοδομοῦμεν τὸν οἶκον ὃς ἦν ᾠκοδομημένος πρὸ τούτου ἔτη πολλά καὶ βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ισραηλ μέγας ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτὸν καὶ κατηρτίσατο αὐτὸν

text_en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath , he delivered them into the hands of Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon the Chaldean : and he destroyed this house, and carried away the people to Babylon .
text_la: Postquam autem ad iracundiam provocaverunt patres nostri Deum cæli, tradidit eos in manus Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis Chaldæi, domum quoque hanc destruxit, et populum ejus transtulit in Babylonem.
text_pt: Mas depois que nossos pais provocaram à ira o Deus dos céus, ele os entregou nas mãos de Nabucodonosor, rei de babilônia, o caldeu, o qual destruiu esta casa, e transportou o povo para babilônia.
text_el: αὐτοῖς ἀφ' ὅτε δὲ παρώργισαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος τοῦ Χαλδαίου καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον κατέλυσεν καὶ τὸν λαὸν ἀπῴκισεν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα

text_en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon , King Cyrus set forth a decree, that this house of God should be built.
text_la: Anno autem primo Cyri regis Babylonis, Cyrus rex proposuit edictum ut domus Dei hæc ædificaretur.
text_pt: Porém, no primeiro ano de Ciro, rei de babilônia, o rei Ciro deu ordem para que esta casa de Deus se reedificasse.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐν ἔτει πρώτῳ Κύρου τοῦ βασιλέως Κῦρος ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔθετο γνώμην τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦτον οἰκοδομηθῆναι

text_en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the temple of God , which Nabuchodonosor had taken out of the temple , that was in Jerusalem , and had brought them to the temple of Babylon , King Cyrus brought out of the temple of Babylon , and they were delivered to one Sassabasar, whom also he appointed governor,
text_la: Nam et vasa templi Dei aurea et argentea, quæ Nabuchodonosor tulerat de templo, quod erat in Jerusalem, et asportaverat ea in templum Babylonis, protulit Cyrus rex de templo Babylonis, et data sunt Sassabasar vocabulo, quem et principem constituit,
text_pt: E até os utensílios de ouro e prata, da casa de Deus, que Nabucodonosor tomou do templo que estava em Jerusalém e os levou para o templo de babilônia, o rei Ciro os tirou do templo de babilônia, e foram dados a um homem cujo nome era Sesbazar, a quem nomeou governador.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σκεύη τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ χρυσᾶ καὶ τὰ ἀργυρᾶ ἃ Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἐξήνεγκεν ἀπὸ οἴκου τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀπήνεγκεν αὐτὰ εἰς ναὸν τοῦ βασιλέως ἐξήνεγκεν αὐτὰ Κῦρος ὁ βασιλεὺς ἀπὸ ναοῦ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Σασαβασαρ τῷ θησαυροφύλακι τῷ ἐπὶ τοῦ θησαυροῦ

text_en: and said to him: Take these vessels, and go, and put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be built in its place.
text_la: dixitque ei : Hæc vasa tolle, et vade, et pone ea in templo, quod est in Jerusalem, et domus Dei ædificetur in loco suo.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Toma estes utensílios, vai e leva-os ao templo que está em Jerusalém, e faze reedificar a casa de Deus, no seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ σκεύη λαβὲ καὶ πορεύου θὲς αὐτὰ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ εἰς τὸν ἑαυτῶν τόπον

text_en: Then came this same Sassabasar, and laid the foundations of the temple of God in Jerusalem , and from that time until now it is in building, and is not yet finished.
text_la: Tunc itaque Sassabasar ille venit et posuit fundamenta templi Dei in Jerusalem, et ex eo tempore usque nunc ædificatur, et necdum completum est.
text_pt: Então veio este Sesbazar, e pôs os fundamentos da casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém, e desde então para cá se está reedificando, e ainda não está acabada.
text_el: τότε Σασαβασαρ ἐκεῖνος ἦλθεν καὶ ἔδωκεν θεμελίους τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀπὸ τότε ἕως τοῦ νῦν ᾠκοδομήθη καὶ οὐκ ἐτελέσθη

text_en: Now therefore if it seem good to the king, let him search in the king's library, which is in Babylon , whether it has been decreed by Cyrus the king, that the house of God in Jerusalem should be built, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
text_la: Nunc ergo si videtur regi bonum, recenseat in bibliotheca regis, quæ est in Babylone, utrumnam a Cyro rege jussum fuerit ut ædificaretur domus Dei in Jerusalem, et voluntatem regis super hac re mittat ad nos.
text_pt: Agora, pois, se parece bem ao rei, busque-se na casa dos tesouros do rei, que está em babilônia, se é verdade que se deu uma ordem pelo rei Ciro para reedificar esta casa de Deus em Jerusalém; e sobre isto nos faça saber a vontade do rei.
text_el: καὶ νῦν εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθόν ἐπισκεπήτω ἐν οἴκῳ τῆς γάζης τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ὅπως γνῷς ὅτι ἀπὸ βασιλέως Κύρου ἐτέθη γνώμη οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ γνοὺς ὁ βασιλεὺς περὶ τούτου πεμψάτω πρὸς ἡμᾶς

text_en: Then King Darius gave orders, and they searched in the library of the books that were laid up in Babylon ,
text_la: Tunc Darius rex præcepit : et recensuerunt in bibliotheca librorum, qui erant repositi in Babylone.
text_pt: Então o rei Dario deu ordem, e buscaram nos arquivos, onde se guardavam os tesouros em babilônia.
text_el: τότε Δαρεῖος ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔθηκεν γνώμην καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο ἐν ταῖς βιβλιοθήκαις ὅπου ἡ γάζα κεῖται ἐν Βαβυλῶνι

text_en: and there was found in Ecbatana, which is a castle in the province of Media , a book in which this record was written.
text_la: Et inventum est in Ecbatanis, quod est castrum in Medena provincia, volumen unum : talisque scriptus erat in eo commentarius:
text_pt: E em Acmeta, no palácio, que está na província de Média, se achou um rolo, e nele estava escrito um memorial que dizia assim:
text_el: καὶ εὑρέθη ἐν πόλει ἐν τῇ βάρει τῆς Μήδων πόλεως κεφαλὶς μία καὶ τοῦτο ἦν γεγραμμένον ἐν αὐτῇ ὑπόμνημα

text_en: In the first year of Cyrus the king: Cyrus the king decreed, that the house of God should be built, which is in Jerusalem , in the place where they may offer sacrifices , and that they lay the foundations that may support the height of threescore cubits, and the breadth of threescore cubits,
text_la: Anno primo Cyri regis, Cyrus rex decrevit ut domus Dei ædificaretur, quæ est in Jerusalem, in loco ubi immolent hostias, et ut ponant fundamenta supportantia altitudinem cubitorum sexaginta, et latitudinem cubitorum sexaginta,
text_pt: No primeiro ano do rei Ciro, este baixou o seguinte decreto: A casa de Deus, em Jerusalém, se reedificará para lugar em que se ofereçam sacrifícios, e seus fundamentos serão firmes; a sua altura de sessenta côvados, e a sua largura de sessenta côvados;
text_el: ἐν ἔτει πρώτῳ Κύρου βασιλέως Κῦρος ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔθηκεν γνώμην περὶ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ οἶκος οἰκοδομηθήτω καὶ τόπος οὗ θυσιάζουσιν τὰ θυσιάσματα καὶ ἔθηκεν ἔπαρμα ὕψος πήχεις ἑξήκοντα πλάτος αὐτοῦ πήχεων ἑξήκοντα

text_en: three rows of unpolished stones, and so rows of new timber: and the charges shall be given out of the king's house.
text_la: ordines de lapidibus impolitis tres, et sic ordines de lignis novis : sumptus autem de domo regis dabuntur.
text_pt: Com três carreiras de grandes pedras, e uma carreira de madeira nova; e a despesa se fará da casa do rei.
text_el: καὶ δόμοι λίθινοι κραταιοὶ τρεῖς καὶ δόμος ξύλινος εἷς καὶ ἡ δαπάνη ἐξ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως δοθήσεται

text_en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the temple of God , which Nabuchodonosor took out of the temple of Jerusalem , and brought to Babylon , be restored, and carried back to the temple of Jerusalem to their place, which also were placed in the temple of God .
text_la: Sed et vasa templi Dei aurea et argentea, quæ Nabuchodonosor tulerat de templo Jerusalem, et attulerat ea in Babylonem, reddantur, et referantur in templum in Jerusalem in locum suum, quæ et posita sunt in templo Dei.
text_pt: Além disso, os utensílios de ouro e de prata da casa de Deus, que Nabucodonosor transportou do templo que estava em Jerusalém, e levou para babilônia, serão restituídos, para que voltem ao seu lugar, ao templo que está em Jerusalém, e serão postos na casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σκεύη οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ἀργυρᾶ καὶ τὰ χρυσᾶ ἃ Ναβουχοδονοσορ ἐξήνεγκεν ἀπὸ οἴκου τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐκόμισεν εἰς Βαβυλῶνα καὶ δοθήτω καὶ ἀπελθάτω εἰς τὸν ναὸν τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐπὶ τόπου οὗ ἐτέθη ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: Now therefore Thathanai, governor of the country beyond the river, Stharbuzanai, and your counsellors the Apharsachites, who are beyond the river, depart far from them,
text_la: Nunc ergo Thathanai dux regionis, quæ est trans flumen, Stharbuzanai, et consiliarii vestri Apharsachæi, qui estis trans flumen, procul recedite ab illis,
text_pt: Agora, pois, Tatenai, governador dalém do rio, Setar-Bozenai, e os seus companheiros, os afarsaquitas, que habitais dalém do rio, apartai-vos dali.
text_el: νῦν δώσετε ἔπαρχοι πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ Σαθαρβουζανα καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν Αφαρσαχαῖοι οἱ ἐν πέρα τοῦ ποταμοῦ μακρὰν ὄντες ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: and let that temple of God be built by the governor of the Jews , and by their ancients, that they may build that house of God in its place.
text_la: et dimittite fieri templum Dei illud a duce Judæorum, et a senioribus eorum, ut domum Dei illam ædificent in loco suo.
text_pt: Deixai que se faça a obra desta casa de Deus; que o governador dos judeus e os seus anciãos reedifiquem esta casa de Deus no seu lugar.
text_el: ἄφετε τὸ ἔργον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι τῶν Ιουδαίων καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τῶν Ιουδαίων οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον οἰκοδομείτωσαν ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτοῦ

text_en: I also have commanded what must be done by those ancients of the Jews , that the house of God may be built, to wit, that of the king's chest, that is, of the tribute that is paid out of the country beyond the river, the charges be diligently given to those men , lest the work be hindered.
text_la: Sed et a me præceptum est quid oporteat fieri a presbyteris Judæorum illis ut ædificetur domus Dei, scilicet ut de arca regis, id est, de tributis quæ dantur de regione trans flumen, studiose sumptus dentur viris illis, ne impediatur opus.
text_pt: Também por mim se decreta o que haveis de fazer com os anciãos dos judeus, para a reedificação desta casa de Deus, a saber: que da fazenda do rei, dos tributos dalém do rio se pague prontamente a despesa a estes homens, para que não interrompam a obra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη μήποτέ τι ποιήσητε μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τῶν Ιουδαίων τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον καὶ ἀπὸ ὑπαρχόντων βασιλέως τῶν φόρων πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐπιμελῶς δαπάνη ἔστω διδομένη τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐκείνοις τὸ μὴ καταργηθῆναι

text_en: And if it shall be necessary, let calves also, and lambs, and kids, for holocausts to the God of heaven , wheat, salt , wine, and oil, according to the custom of the priests that are in Jerusalem , be given them day by day, that there be no complaint in anything.
text_la: Quod si necesse fuerit, et vitulos, et agnos, et hædos in holocaustum Deo cæli, frumentum, sal, vinum, et oleum, secundum ritum sacerdotum, qui sunt in Jerusalem, detur eis per singulos dies, ne sit in aliquo querimonia.
text_pt: E o que for necessário, como bezerros, carneiros, e cordeiros, para holocaustos ao Deus dos céus, trigo, sal, vinho e azeite, segundo o rito dos sacerdotes que estão em Jerusalém, dê-se-lhes, de dia em dia, para que não haja falta.
text_el: καὶ ὃ ἂν ὑστέρημα καὶ υἱοὺς βοῶν καὶ κριῶν καὶ ἀμνοὺς εἰς ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πυρούς ἅλας οἶνον ἔλαιον κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τῶν ἱερέων τῶν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἔστω διδόμενον αὐτοῖς ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσωσιν

text_en: And let them offer oblations to the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king, and of his children.
text_la: Et offerant oblationes Deo cæli, orentque pro vita regis, et filiorum ejus.
text_pt: Para que ofereçam sacrifícios de cheiro suave ao Deus dos céus, e orem pela vida do rei e de seus filhos.
text_el: ἵνα ὦσιν προσφέροντες εὐωδίας τῷ θεῷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ προσεύχωνται εἰς ζωὴν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I have made a decree: That if any whosoever, shall alter this commandment, a beam be taken from his house, and set up, and he be nailed upon it, and his house be confiscated.
text_la: A me ergo positum est decretum : ut omnis homo qui hanc mutaverit jussionem, tollatur lignum de domum ipsius, et erigatur, et configatur in eo, domus autem ejus publicetur.
text_pt: Também por mim se decreta que todo o homem que mudar este decreto, se arrancará um madeiro da sua casa, e, levantado, o pendurarão nele, e da sua casa se fará por isso um monturo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη ὅτι πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἀλλάξει τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καθαιρεθήσεται ξύλον ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ὠρθωμένος παγήσεται ἐπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ τὸ κατ' ἐμὲ ποιηθήσεται

text_en: And may the God , that has caused his name to dwell there, destroy all kingdoms, and the people that shall put out their hand to resist, and to destroy the house of God , that is in Jerusalem . I Darius have made the decree, which I will have diligently complied with.
text_la: Deus autem, qui habitare fecit nomen suum ibi, dissipet omnia regna, et populum qui extenderit manum suam ut repugnet, et dissipet domum Dei illam, quæ est in Jerusalem. Ego Darius statui decretum, quod studiose impleri volo.
text_pt: O Deus, pois, que fez habitar ali o seu nome derrube a todos os reis e povos que estenderem a sua mão para mudar o decreto e para destruir esta casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém. Eu, Dario, baixei o decreto; com diligência se faça.
text_el: καὶ ὁ θεός οὗ κατασκηνοῖ τὸ ὄνομα ἐκεῖ καταστρέψει πάντα βασιλέα καὶ λαόν ὃς ἐκτενεῖ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἀλλάξαι ἢ ἀφανίσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκεῖνον τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐγὼ Δαρεῖος ἔθηκα γνώμην ἐπιμελῶς ἔσται

text_en: So then Thathanai, governor of the country beyond the river, and Stharbuzanai, and his counsellors diligently executed what Darius the king had commanded.
text_la: Igitur Thathanai dux regionis trans flumen, et Stharbuzanai, et consiliarii ejus, secundum quod præceperat Darius rex, sic diligenter executi sunt.
text_pt: Então Tatenai, o governador dalém do rio, Setar-Bozenai e os seus companheiros, assim fizeram diligentemente, conforme ao que decretara o rei Dario.
text_el: τότε Θανθαναι ἔπαρχος πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ Σαθαρβουζανα καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτοῦ πρὸς ὃ ἀπέστειλεν Δαρεῖος ὁ βασιλεὺς οὕτως ἐποίησαν ἐπιμελῶς

text_en: And the ancients of the Jews built, and prospered according to the prophecy of Aggeus the prophet , and of Zacharias the son of Addo: and they built and finished, by the commandment of the God of Israel , and by the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes kings of the Persians.
text_la: Seniores autem Judæorum ædificabant, et prosperabantur juxta prophetiam Aggæi prophetæ, et Zachariæ filii Addo : et ædificaverunt et construxerunt, jubente Deo Israël, et jubente Cyro, et Dario, et Artaxerxe regibus Persarum:
text_pt: E os anciãos dos judeus iam edificando e prosperando pela profecia do profeta Ageu, e de Zacarias, filho de Ido. E edificaram e terminaram a obra conforme ao mandado do Deus de Israel, e conforme ao decreto de Ciro e Dario, e de Artaxerxes, rei da Pérsia.
text_el: καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τῶν Ιουδαίων ᾠκοδομοῦσαν καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἐν προφητείᾳ Αγγαιου τοῦ προφήτου καὶ Ζαχαριου υἱοῦ Αδδω καὶ ἀνῳκοδόμησαν καὶ κατηρτίσαντο ἀπὸ γνώμης θεοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπὸ γνώμης Κύρου καὶ Δαρείου καὶ Αρθασασθα βασιλέων Περσῶν

text_en: And they were finishing this house of God , until the third day of the month of Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
text_la: et compleverunt domum Dei istam, usque ad diem tertium mensis Adar, qui est annus sextus regni Darii regis.
text_pt: E acabou-se esta casa no terceiro dia do mês de Adar, no sexto ano do reinado do rei Dario.
text_el: καὶ ἐτέλεσαν τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον ἕως ἡμέρας τρίτης μηνὸς Αδαρ ὅ ἐστιν ἔτος ἕκτον τῇ βασιλείᾳ Δαρείου τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And the children of Israel , the priests and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity kept the dedication of the house of God with joy .
text_la: Fecerunt autem filii Israël sacerdotes et Levitæ, et reliqui filiorum transmigrationis, dedicationem domus Dei in gaudio.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel, os sacerdotes, os levitas, e o restante dos filhos do cativeiro, fizeram a dedicação desta casa de Deus com alegria.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι υἱῶν ἀποικεσίας ἐγκαίνια τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ

text_en: And they offered at the dedication of the house of God , a hundred calves, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and for a sin offering for all Israel twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
text_la: Et obtulerunt in dedicationem domus Dei, vitulos centum, arietes ducentos, agnos quadringentos, hircos caprarum pro peccato totius Israël duodecim, juxta numerum tribuum Israël.
text_pt: E ofereceram para a dedicação desta casa de Deus cem novilhos, duzentos carneiros, quatrocentos cordeiros, e doze cabritos por expiação do pecado de todo o Israel; segundo o número das tribos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ προσήνεγκαν εἰς τὰ ἐγκαίνια τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ μόσχους ἑκατόν κριοὺς διακοσίους ἀμνοὺς τετρακοσίους χιμάρους αἰγῶν περὶ ἁμαρτίας ὑπὲρ παντὸς Ισραηλ δώδεκα εἰς ἀριθμὸν φυλῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses over the works of God in Jerusalem , as it is written in the book of Moses .
text_la: Et statuerunt sacerdotes in ordinibus suis, et Levitas in vicibus suis, super opera Dei in Jerusalem, sicut scriptum est in libro Moysi.
text_pt: E puseram os sacerdotes nas suas turmas e os levitas nas suas divisões, para o ministério de Deus, em Jerusalém, conforme ao que está escrito no livro de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἐν διαιρέσεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας ἐν μερισμοῖς αὐτῶν ἐπὶ δουλείᾳ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κατὰ τὴν γραφὴν βιβλίου Μωυσῆ

text_en: And the children of Israel of the captivity kept the phase , on the fourteenth day of the first month.
text_la: Fecerunt autem filii Israël transmigrationis Pascha, quartadecima die mensis primi.
text_pt: E os filhos do cativeiro celebraram a páscoa no dia catorze do primeiro mês.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς ἀποικεσίας τὸ πασχα τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου

text_en: For all the priests and the Levites were purified as one man : all were clean to kill the phase for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests , and themselves.
text_la: Purificati enim fuerant sacerdotes et Levitæ quasi unus : omnes mundi ad immolandum Pascha universis filiis transmigrationis, et fratribus suis sacerdotibus, et sibi.
text_pt: Porque os sacerdotes e levitas se purificaram como se fossem um só homem, todos estavam limpos; e mataram o cordeiro da páscoa para todos os filhos do cativeiro, e para seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, e para si mesmos.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκαθαρίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἕως εἷς πάντες καθαροὶ καὶ ἔσφαξαν τὸ πασχα τοῖς πᾶσιν υἱοῖς τῆς ἀποικεσίας καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ ἑαυτοῖς

text_en: And the children of Israel that were returned from captivity, and all that had separated themselves from the filthiness of the nations of the earth to them, to seek the Lord the God of Israel , ate.
text_la: Et comederunt filii Israël, qui reversi fuerant de transmigratione, et omnes qui se separaverant a coinquinatione gentium terræ ad eos, ut quærerent Dominum Deum Israël.
text_pt: Assim comeram a páscoa os filhos de Israel que tinham voltado do cativeiro, com todos os que com eles se apartaram da imundícia dos gentios da terra, para buscarem o Senhor Deus de Israel;
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πασχα οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀποικεσίας καὶ πᾶς ὁ χωριζόμενος τῆς ἀκαθαρσίας ἐθνῶν τῆς γῆς πρὸς αὐτοὺς τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι κύριον θεὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy , for the Lord had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, that he should help their hands in the work of the house of the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Et fecerunt solemnitatem azymorum septem diebus in lætitia, quoniam lætificaverat eos Dominus, et converterat cor regis Assur ad eos, ut adjuvaret manus eorum in opere domus Domini Dei Israël.
text_pt: E celebraram a festa dos pães ázimos por sete dias com alegria; porque o Senhor os tinha alegrado, e tinha mudado o coração do rei da Assíria a favor deles, para lhes fortalecer as mãos na obra da casa de Deus, o Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν τὴν ἑορτὴν τῶν ἀζύμων ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ ὅτι εὔφρανεν αὐτοὺς κύριος καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν καρδίαν βασιλέως Ασσουρ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς κραταιῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἐν ἔργοις οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: Now after these things in the reign of Artaxerxes king of the Persians, Esdras the son of Saraias , the son of Azarias, the son of Helcias,
text_la: Post hæc autem verba in regno Artaxerxis regis Persarum, Esdras filius Saraiæ, filii Azariæ, filii Helciæ,
text_pt: E passadas estas coisas no reinado de Artaxerxes, rei da Pérsia, Esdras, filho de Seraías, filho de Azarias, filho de Hilquias,
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐν βασιλείᾳ Αρθασασθα βασιλέως Περσῶν ἀνέβη Εσδρας υἱὸς Σαραιου υἱοῦ Αζαριου υἱοῦ Ελκια

text_en: the son of Sellum, the son of Sadoc, the son of Achitob,
text_la: filii Sellum, filii Sadoc, filii Achitob,
text_pt: Filho de Salum, filho de Zadoque, filho de Aitube,
text_el: υἱοῦ Σαλουμ υἱοῦ Σαδδουκ υἱοῦ Αχιτωβ

text_en: the son of Amarias, the son of Azarias, the son of Maraioth,
text_la: filii Amariæ, filii Azariæ, filii Maraioth,
text_pt: Filho de Amarias, filho de Azarias, filho de Meraiote,
text_el: υἱοῦ Σαμαρια υἱοῦ Εσρια υἱοῦ Μαρερωθ

text_en: the son of Zarahias, the son of Ozi, the son of Bocci,
text_la: filii Zarahiæ, filii Ozi, filii Bocci,
text_pt: Filho de Zeraquias, filho de Uzi, filho de Buqui,
text_el: υἱοῦ Ζαραια υἱοῦ Σαουια υἱοῦ Βοκκι

text_en: the son of Abisue, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , the priest from the beginning.
text_la: filii Abisue, filii Phinees, filii Eleazar, filii Aaron sacerdotis ab initio.
text_pt: Filho de Abisua, filho de Finéias, filho de Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sumo sacerdote;
text_el: υἱοῦ Αβισουε υἱοῦ Φινεες υἱοῦ Ελεαζαρ υἱοῦ Ααρων τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ πρώτου

text_en: This Esdras went up from Babylon , and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses , which the Lord God had given to Israel : and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.
text_la: Ipse Esdras ascendit de Babylone, et ipse scriba velox in lege Moysi, quam Dominus Deus dedit Israël : et dedit ei rex secundum manum Domini Dei ejus super eum, omnem petitionem ejus.
text_pt: Este Esdras subiu de babilônia; e era escriba hábil na lei de Moisés, que o SENHOR Deus de Israel tinha dado; e, segundo a mão do SENHOR seu Deus, que estava sobre ele, o rei lhe deu tudo quanto lhe pedira.
text_el: αὐτὸς Εσδρας ἀνέβη ἐκ Βαβυλῶνος καὶ αὐτὸς γραμματεὺς ταχὺς ἐν νόμῳ Μωυσῆ ὃν ἔδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ὅτι χεὶρ κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐζήτει αὐτός

text_en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the children of the priests , and of the children of the Levites , and of the singing men , and of the porters, and of the Nathinites to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
text_la: Et ascenderunt de filiis Israël, et de filiis sacerdotum, et de filiis Levitarum, et de cantoribus, et de janitoribus, et de Nathinæis, in Jerusalem, anno septimo Artaxerxis regis.
text_pt: Também subiram a Jerusalém alguns dos filhos de Israel, dos sacerdotes, dos levitas, dos cantores, dos porteiros e dos servidores do templo, no sétimo ano do rei Artaxerxes.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευιτῶν καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ναθινιμ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἔτει ἑβδόμῳ τῷ Αρθασασθα τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And they came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king.
text_la: Et venerunt in Jerusalem mense quinto, ipse est annus septimus regis.
text_pt: E no quinto mês chegou a Jerusalém, no sétimo ano deste rei.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ τοῦτο ἔτος ἕβδομον τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: For upon the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem according to the good hand of his God upon him.
text_la: Quia in primo die mensis primi cœpit ascendere de Babylone, et in primo die mensis quinti venit in Jerusalem, juxta manum Dei sui bonam super se.
text_pt: Pois no primeiro dia do primeiro mês foi o princípio da partida de babilônia; e no primeiro dia do quinto mês chegou a Jerusalém, segundo a boa mão do seu Deus sobre ele.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν τὴν ἀνάβασιν τὴν ἀπὸ Βαβυλῶνος ἐν δὲ τῇ πρώτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πέμπτου ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι χεὶρ θεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἦν ἀγαθὴ ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: For Esdras had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord , and to do and to teach in Israel the commandments and judgment.
text_la: Esdras enim paravit cor suum, ut investigaret legem Domini, et faceret et doceret in Israël præceptum et judicium.
text_pt: Porque Esdras tinha preparado o seu coração para buscar a lei do Senhor e para cumpri-la e para ensinar em Israel os seus estatutos e os seus juízos.
text_el: ὅτι Εσδρας ἔδωκεν ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν νόμον καὶ ποιεῖν καὶ διδάσκειν ἐν Ισραηλ προστάγματα καὶ κρίματα
