text_en: And this is the copy of the letter of the edict, which King Artaxerxes gave to Esdras the priest , the scribe instructed in the words and commandments of the Lord , and his ceremonies in Israel .
text_la: Hoc est autem exemplar epistolæ edicti, quod dedit rex Artaxerxes Esdræ sacerdoti, scribæ erudito in sermonibus et præceptis Domini, et cæremoniis ejus in Israël.
text_pt: Esta é, pois, a cópia da carta que o rei Artaxerxes deu ao sacerdote Esdras, o escriba das palavras dos mandamentos do Senhor, e dos seus estatutos sobre Israel:
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ διασάφησις τοῦ διατάγματος οὗ ἔδωκεν Αρθασασθα τῷ Εσδρα τῷ ἱερεῖ τῷ γραμματεῖ βιβλίου λόγων ἐντολῶν κυρίου καὶ προσταγμάτων αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: Artaxerxes king of kings to Esdras the priest , the most learned scribe of the law of the God of heaven , greeting.
text_la: Artaxerxes rex regum Esdræ sacerdoti scribæ legis Dei cæli doctissimo, salutem.
text_pt: Artaxerxes, rei dos reis, ao sacerdote Esdras, escriba da lei do Deus do céu, paz perfeita, em tal tempo.
text_el: Αρθασασθα βασιλεὺς βασιλέων Εσδρα γραμματεῖ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τετέλεσται ὁ λόγος καὶ ἡ ἀπόκρισις

text_en: It is decreed by me, that all they of the people of Israel , and of the priests and of the Levites in my realm, that are minded to go into Jerusalem , should go with you.
text_la: A me decretum est, ut cuicumque placuerit in regno meo de populo Israël, et de sacerdotibus ejus, et de Levitis, ire in Jerusalem, tecum vadat.
text_pt: Por mim se decreta que no meu reino todo aquele do povo de Israel, e dos seus sacerdotes e levitas, que quiser ir contigo a Jerusalém, vá.
text_el: ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐτέθη γνώμη ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ἑκουσιαζόμενος ἐν βασιλείᾳ μου ἀπὸ λαοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἱερέων καὶ Λευιτῶν πορευθῆναι εἰς Ιερουσαλημ μετὰ σοῦ πορευθῆναι

text_en: For you are sent from before the king, and his seven counsellors, to visit Judea and Jerusalem according to the law of your God , which is in your hand.
text_la: A facie enim regis, et septem consiliatorum ejus, missus es, ut visites Judæam et Jerusalem in lege Dei tui, quæ est in manu tua:
text_pt: Porquanto és enviado da parte do rei e dos seus sete conselheiros para fazeres inquirição a respeito de Judá e de Jerusalém, conforme à lei do teu Deus, que está na tua mão;
text_el: ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἑπτὰ συμβούλων ἀπεστάλη ἐπισκέψασθαι ἐπὶ τὴν Ιουδαίαν καὶ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ νόμῳ θεοῦ αὐτῶν τῷ ἐν χειρί σου

text_en: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Israel , whose tabernacle is in Jerusalem .
text_la: et ut feras argentum et aurum quod rex, et consiliatores ejus, sponte obtulerunt Deo Israël, cujus in Jerusalem tabernaculum est.
text_pt: E para levares a prata e o ouro que o rei e os seus conselheiros voluntariamente deram ao Deus de Israel, cuja habitação está em Jerusalém;
text_el: καὶ εἰς οἶκον κυρίου ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ὃ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ σύμβουλοι ἡκουσιάσθησαν τῷ θεῷ τοῦ Ισραηλ τῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κατασκηνοῦντι

text_en: And all the silver and gold that you shall find in all the province of Babylon , and that the people is willing to offer, and that the priests shall offer of their own accord to the house of their God , which is in Jerusalem ,
text_la: Et omne argentum et aurum quodcumque inveneris in universa provincia Babylonis, et populus offerre voluerit, et de sacerdotibus quæ sponte obtulerint domui Dei sui, quæ est in Jerusalem,
text_pt: E toda a prata e o ouro que achares em toda a província de babilônia, com as ofertas voluntárias do povo e dos sacerdotes, que voluntariamente oferecerem, para a casa de seu Deus, que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον ὅ τι ἐὰν εὕρῃς ἐν πάσῃ χώρᾳ Βαβυλῶνος μετὰ ἑκουσιασμοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἱερέων τῶν ἑκουσιαζομένων εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: take freely, and buy diligently with this money, calves, rams, lambs, with the sacrifices and libations of them, and offer them upon the altar of the temple of your God , that is in Jerusalem .
text_la: libere accipe, et studiose eme de hac pecunia vitulos, arietes, agnos, et sacrificia, et libamina eorum, et offer ea super altare templi Dei vestri, quod est in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Portanto diligentemente comprarás com este dinheiro novilhos, carneiros, cordeiros, com as suas ofertas de alimentos, e as suas libações, e as oferecerás sobre o altar da casa de vosso Deus, que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν προσπορευόμενον τοῦτον ἑτοίμως ἔνταξον ἐν βιβλίῳ τούτῳ μόσχους κριούς ἀμνοὺς καὶ θυσίας αὐτῶν καὶ σπονδὰς αὐτῶν καὶ προσοίσεις αὐτὰ ἐπὶ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And if it seem good to you, and to your brethren to do anything with the rest of the silver and gold, do it according to the will of your God .
text_la: Sed et si quid tibi et fratribus tuis placuerit de reliquo argento et auro ut faciatis, juxta voluntatem Dei vestri facite.
text_pt: Também o que a ti e a teus irmãos bem parecer fazerdes do restante da prata e do ouro, o fareis conforme a vontade do vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἴ τι ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου ἀγαθυνθῇ ἐν καταλοίπῳ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου ποιῆσαι ὡς ἀρεστὸν τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν ποιήσατε

text_en: The vessels also, that are given you for the sacrifice of the house of your God , deliver in the sight of God in Jerusalem .
text_la: Vasa quoque, quæ dantur tibi in ministerium domus Dei tui, trade in conspectu Dei in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E os utensílios que te foram dados para o serviço da casa de teu Deus, restitui-os perante o Deus de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ τὰ σκεύη τὰ διδόμενά σοι εἰς λειτουργίαν οἴκου θεοῦ παράδος ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And whatsoever more there shall be need of for the house of your God , how much soever you shall have occasion to spend, it shall be given out of the treasury, and the king's exchequer, and by me.
text_la: Sed et cetera, quibus opus fuerit in domum Dei tui, quantumcumque necesse est ut expendas, dabitur de thesauro, et de fisco regis,
text_pt: E tudo mais que for necessário para a casa de teu Deus, que te convenha dar, dá-lo-ás da casa dos tesouros do rei.
text_el: καὶ κατάλοιπον χρείας οἴκου θεοῦ σου ὃ ἂν φανῇ σοι δοῦναι δώσεις ἀπὸ οἴκων γάζης βασιλέως

text_en: I Artaxerxes the king have ordered and decreed to all the keepers of the public chest, that are beyond the river, that whatsoever Esdras the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you, you give it without delay,
text_la: et a me. Ego Artaxerxes rex, statui atque decrevi omnibus custodibus arcæ publicæ, qui sunt trans flumen, ut quodcumque petierit a vobis Esdras sacerdos, scriba legis Dei cæli, absque mora detis,
text_pt: E por mim mesmo, o rei Artaxerxes, se decreta a todos os tesoureiros que estão dalém do rio que tudo quanto vos pedir o sacerdote Esdras, escriba da lei do Deus dos céus, prontamente se faça.
text_el: καὶ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ ἐγὼ Αρθασασθα βασιλεύς ἔθηκα γνώμην πάσαις ταῖς γάζαις ταῖς ἐν πέρα τοῦ ποταμοῦ ὅτι πᾶν ὃ ἂν αἰτήσῃ ὑμᾶς Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ γραμματεὺς τοῦ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἑτοίμως γιγνέσθω

text_en: unto a hundred talents of silver, and unto a hundred cores of wheat, and unto a hundred bates of wine, and unto a hundred bates of oil, and salt without measure.
text_la: usque ad argenti talenta centum, et usque ad frumenti coros centum, et usque ad vini batos centum, et usque ad batos olei centum, sal vero absque mensura.
text_pt: Até cem talentos de prata, e até cem coros de trigo, e até cem batos de vinho, e até cem batos de azeite; e sal à vontade.
text_el: ἕως ἀργυρίου ταλάντων ἑκατὸν καὶ ἕως πυροῦ κόρων ἑκατὸν καὶ ἕως οἴνου βάδων ἑκατὸν καὶ ἕως ἐλαίου βάδων ἑκατὸν καὶ ἅλας οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν γραφή

text_en: All that belongs to the rites of the God of heaven , let it be given diligently in the house of the God of heaven : lest his wrath should be enkindled against the realm of the king, and of his sons.
text_la: Omne quod ad ritum Dei cæli pertinet, tribuatur diligenter in domo Dei cæli : ne forte irascatur contra regnum regis, et filiorum ejus.
text_pt: Tudo quanto se ordenar, segundo o mandado do Deus do céu, prontamente se faça para a casa do Deus dos céus; pois, para que haveria grande ira sobre o reino do rei e de seus filhos?
text_el: πᾶν ὅ ἐστιν ἐν γνώμῃ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ γιγνέσθω προσέχετε μή τις ἐπιχειρήσῃ εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ μήποτε γένηται ὀργὴ ἐπὶ τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: We give you also to understand concerning all the priests , and the Levites , and the singers, and the porters, and the Nathinites , and ministers of the house of this God , that you have no authority to impose toll or tribute, or custom upon them.
text_la: Vobis quoque notum facimus de universis sacerdotibus, et Levitis, et cantoribus, et janitoribus, Nathinæis, et ministris domus Dei hujus, ut vectigal, et tributum, et annonas non habeatis potestatem imponendi super eos.
text_pt: Também vos fazemos saber acerca de todos os sacerdotes e levitas, cantores, porteiros, servidores do templo e ministros desta casa de Deus, que não será lícito impor-lhes, nem tributo, nem contribuição, nem renda.
text_el: καὶ ὑμῖν ἐγνώρισται ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς Λευίταις ᾄδουσιν πυλωροῖς ναθινιμ καὶ λειτουργοῖς οἴκου θεοῦ τούτου φόρος μὴ ἔστω σοι οὐκ ἐξουσιάσεις καταδουλοῦσθαι αὐτούς

text_en: And you Esdras according to the wisdom of your God , which is in your hand, appoint judges and magistrates, that may judge all the people, that is beyond the river, that is, for them who know the law of your God , yea and the ignorant teach freely.
text_la: Tu autem Esdra, secundum sapientiam Dei tui, quæ est in manu tua, constitue judices et præsides, ut judicent omni populo qui est trans flumen, his videlicet qui noverunt legem Dei tui : sed et imperitos docete libere.
text_pt: E tu, Esdras, conforme a sabedoria do teu Deus, que possues, nomeia magistrados e juízes, que julguem a todo o povo que está dalém do rio, a todos os que sabem as leis do teu Deus; e ao que não as sabe, lhe ensinarás.
text_el: καὶ σύ Εσδρα ὡς ἡ σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν χειρί σου κατάστησον γραμματεῖς καὶ κριτάς ἵνα ὦσιν κρίνοντες παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τῷ ἐν πέρα τοῦ ποταμοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς εἰδόσιν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ σου καὶ τῷ μὴ εἰδότι γνωριεῖτε

text_en: And whosoever will not do the law of your God , and the law of the king diligently, judgment shall be executed upon him, either unto death, or unto banishment, or to the confiscation of goods, or at least to prison.
text_la: Et omnis qui non fecerit legem Dei tui, et legem regis, diligenter, judicium erit de eo sive in mortem, sive in exilium, sive in condemnationem substantiæ ejus, vel certe in carcerem.
text_pt: E todo aquele que não observar a lei do teu Deus e a lei do rei, seja julgado prontamente; quer seja morte, quer desterro, quer multa sobre os seus bens, quer prisão.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἂν μὴ ᾖ ποιῶν νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ νόμον τοῦ βασιλέως ἑτοίμως τὸ κρίμα ἔσται γιγνόμενον ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐάν τε εἰς θάνατον ἐάν τε εἰς παιδείαν ἐάν τε εἰς ζημίαν τοῦ βίου ἐάν τε εἰς δεσμά

text_en: Blessed be the Lord the God of our fathers, who has put this in the king's heart, to glorify the house of the Lord , which is in Jerusalem ,
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus patrum nostrorum, qui dedit hoc in corde regis ut glorificaret domum Domini quæ est in Jerusalem,
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de nossos pais, que tal inspirou ao coração do rei, para ornar a casa do Senhor, que está em Jerusalém.
text_el: εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ὃς ἔδωκεν οὕτως ἐν καρδίᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως τοῦ δοξάσαι τὸν οἶκον κυρίου τὸν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: and has inclined his mercy toward me before the king and his counsellors, and all the mighty princes of the king: and I being strengthened by the hand of the Lord my God , which was upon me, gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
text_la: et in me inclinavit misericordiam suam coram rege et consiliatoribus ejus, et universis principibus regis potentibus : et ego confortatus manu Domini Dei mei, quæ erat in me, congregavi de Israël principes qui ascenderent mecum.
text_pt: E que estendeu para mim a sua benignidade perante o rei e os seus conselheiros e todos os príncipes poderosos do rei. Assim me animei, segundo a mão do Senhor meu Deus sobre mim, e ajuntei dentre Israel alguns chefes para subirem comigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἔκλινεν ἔλεος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν συμβούλων αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντων τῶν ἀρχόντων τοῦ βασιλέως τῶν ἐπηρμένων καὶ ἐγὼ ἐκραταιώθην ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθὴ ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ συνῆξα ἀπὸ Ισραηλ ἄρχοντας ἀναβῆναι μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Now these are the chief of families , and the genealogy of them, who came up with me from Babylon in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
text_la: Hi sunt ergo principes familiarum, et genealogia eorum, qui ascenderunt mecum in regno Artaxerxis regis de Babylone.
text_pt: Estes, pois, são os chefes das casas paternas e esta a genealogia dos que subiram comigo de babilônia no reinado do rei Artaxerxes:
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες πατριῶν αὐτῶν οἱ ὁδηγοὶ ἀναβαίνοντες μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν βασιλείᾳ Αρθασασθα τοῦ βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος

text_en: Of the sons of Phinees, Gersom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David , Hattus.
text_la: De filiis Phinees, Gersom. De filiis Ithamar, Daniel. De filiis David, Hattus.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Finéias, Gérson; dos filhos de Itamar, Daniel; dos filhos de Davi, Hatus;
text_el: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φινεες Γηρσωμ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιθαμαρ Δανιηλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Δαυιδ Ατους

text_en: Of the sons of Sechenias, the son of Pharos, Zacharias, and with him were numbered a hundred and fifty men .
text_la: De filiis Secheniæ, filiis Pharos, Zacharias : et cum eo numerati sunt viri centum quinquaginta.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Secanias, e dos filhos de Parós, Zacarias, e com ele, segundo a genealogia, se contaram até cento e cinqüenta homens.
text_el: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Σαχανια ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φορος Ζαχαριας καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ τὸ σύστρεμμα ἑκατὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα

text_en: Of the sons of Phahath Moab , Eleoenai the son of Zareha, and with him two hundred men .
text_la: De filiis Phahath Moab, Elioënai filius Zarehe, et cum eo ducenti viri.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Paate-Moabe, Elioenai, filho de Zacarias, e com ele duzentos homens.
text_el: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φααθμωαβ Ελιανα υἱὸς Ζαραια καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Sechenias, the son of Ezechiel, and with him three hundred men .
text_la: De filiis Secheniæ, filius Ezechiel, et cum eo trecenti viri.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Secanias, o filho de Jeaziel, e com ele trezentos homens.
text_el: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ζαθοης Σεχενιας υἱὸς Αζιηλ καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ τριακόσιοι τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Adan, Abed the son of Jonathan , and with him fifty men .
text_la: De filiis Adan, Abed filius Jonathan, et cum eo quinquaginta viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Adim, Ebede, filho de Jônatas, e com ele cinqüenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Αδιν Ωβηθ υἱὸς Ιωναθαν καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ πεντήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Alam, Isaias the son of Athalias, and with him seventy men .
text_la: De filiis Alam, Isaias filius Athaliæ, et cum eo septuaginta viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Elão, Jesaías, filho de Atalias, e com ele setenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηλαμ Ιεσια υἱὸς Αθελια καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Saphatia: Zebodia the son of Michael, and with him eighty men .
text_la: De filiis Saphatiæ, Zebedia filius Michaël, et cum eo octoginta viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Sefatias, Zebadias, filho de Micael, e com ele oitenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Σαφατια Ζαβδια υἱὸς Μιχαηλ καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὀγδοήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Joab, Obedia the son of Jahiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen men .
text_la: De filiis Joab, Obedia filius Jahiel, et cum eo ducenti decem et octo viri.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Joabe, Obadias, filho de Jeiel, e com ele duzentos e dezoito homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιωαβ Αβαδια υἱὸς Ιιηλ καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι δέκα ὀκτὼ τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Selomith, the son of Josphia, and with him a hundred and sixty men .
text_la: De filiis Selomith, filius Josphiæ, et cum eo centum sexaginta viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Selomite, o filho de Josifias, e com ele cento e sessenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαανι Σαλιμουθ υἱὸς Ιωσεφια καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν ἑξήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Bebai, Zacharias the son of Bebai: and with him eight and twenty men .
text_la: De filiis Bebai, Zacharias filius Bebai, et cum eo viginti octo viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Bebai, Zacarias, o filho de Bebai, e com ele vinte e oito homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαβι Ζαχαρια υἱὸς Βαβι καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα ὀκτὼ τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Azgad, Joanan the son of Eccetan, and with him a hundred and ten men .
text_la: De filiis Azgad, Johanan filius Eccetan, et cum eo centum et decem viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Azgade, Joanã, o filho de Hacatã, e com ele cento e dez homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ασγαδ Ιωαναν υἱὸς Ακαταν καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν δέκα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Adonicam, who were the last: and these are their names : Eliphelet, and Jehiel, and Samaias, and with them sixty men .
text_la: De filiis Adonicam, qui erant novissimi : et hæc nomina eorum : Elipheleth, et Jehiel, et Samaias, et cum eis sexaginta viri.
text_pt: E dos últimos filhos de Adonicão, cujos nomes eram estes: Elifelete, Jeiel e Semaías, e com eles sessenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Αδωνικαμ ἔσχατοι καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Αλιφαλατ Ιιηλ καὶ Σαμαια καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν ἑξήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: Of the sons of Begui, Uthai and Zachur, and with them seventy men .
text_la: De filii Begui, Uthai et Zachur, et cum eis septuaginta viri.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Bigvai, Utai e Zabude, e com eles setenta homens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαγο Ουθι καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑβδομήκοντα τὰ ἀρσενικά

text_en: And I gathered them together to the river, which runs down to Ahava, and we stayed there three days: and I sought among the people and among the priests for the sons of Levi , and found none there.
text_la: Congregavi autem eos ad fluvium qui decurrit ad Ahava, et mansimus ibi tribus diebus : quæsivique in populo et in sacerdotibus de filiis Levi, et non inveni ibi.
text_pt: E ajuntei-os perto do rio que vai a Aava, e ficamos ali acampados três dias. Então atentei para o povo e para os sacerdotes, e não achei ali nenhum dos filhos de Levi.
text_el: καὶ συνῆξα αὐτοὺς πρὸς τὸν ποταμὸν τὸν ἐρχόμενον πρὸς τὸν Ευι καὶ παρενεβάλομεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς καὶ συνῆκα ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Λευι οὐχ εὗρον ἐκεῖ

text_en: So I sent Eliezer, and Ariel, and Semeias, and Elnathan, and Jarib, and another Elnathan, and Nathan , and Zacharias, and Mosollam, chief men : and Joiarib, and Elnathan, wise men .
text_la: Itaque misi Eliezer, et Ariel, et Semeiam, et Elnathan, et Jarib, et alterum Elnathan, et Nathan, et Zachariam, et Mosollam principes : et Jojarib, et Elnathan sapientes.
text_pt: Enviei, pois, Eliezer, Ariel, Semaías, Elnatã, Jaribe, Elnatã, Natã, Zacarias e Mesulão, os chefes; como também a Joiaribe, e a Elnatã, que eram entendidos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλα τῷ Ελεαζαρ τῷ Αριηλ τῷ Σαμαια καὶ τῷ Αλωναμ καὶ τῷ Ιαριβ καὶ τῷ Ελναθαν καὶ τῷ Ναθαν καὶ τῷ Ζαχαρια καὶ τῷ Μεσουλαμ ἄνδρας καὶ τῷ Ιωαριβ καὶ τῷ Ελναθαν συνίοντας

text_en: And I sent them to Eddo, who is chief in the place of Chasphia, and I put in their mouth the words that they should speak to Eddo, and his brethren the Nathinites in the place of Chasphia, that they should bring us ministers of the house of our God .
text_la: Et misi eos ad Eddo, qui est primus in Chasphiæ loco, et posui in ore eorum verba, quæ loquerentur ad Eddo, et fratres ejus Nathinæos in loco Chasphiæ, ut adducerent nobis ministros domus Dei nostri.
text_pt: E enviei-os com mandado a Ido, chefe em Casifia; e falei a eles o que deveriam dizer a Ido e aos seus irmãos, servidores do templo, em Casifia, que nos trouxessem ministros para a casa do nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκα αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ἄρχοντος ἐν ἀργυρίῳ τοῦ τόπου καὶ ἔθηκα ἐν στόματι αὐτῶν λόγους λαλῆσαι πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν τοὺς ναθινιμ ἐν ἀργυρίῳ τοῦ τόπου τοῦ ἐνέγκαι ἡμῖν ᾄδοντας εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And by the good hand of our God upon us, they brought us a most learned man of the sons of Moholi the son of Levi the son of Israel , and Sarabias and his sons, and his brethren eighteen,
text_la: Et adduxerunt nobis per manum Dei nostri bonam super nos, virum doctissimum de filiis Moholi filii Levi, filii Israël, et Sarabiam et filios ejus et fratres ejus decem et octo,
text_pt: E trouxeram-nos, segundo a boa mão de Deus sobre nós, um homem entendido, dos filhos de Mali, filho de Levi, filho de Israel, a saber: Serebias, com os seus filhos e irmãos, dezoito;
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἡμῖν ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἀνὴρ σαχωλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Μοολι υἱοῦ Λευι υἱοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ ἀρχὴν ἤλθοσαν υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὀκτωκαίδεκα

text_en: and Hasabias, and with him Isaias of the sons of Merari, and his brethren, and his sons twenty.
text_la: et Hasabiam, et cum eo Isaiam de filiis Merari, fratresque ejus, et filios ejus viginti:
text_pt: E a Hasabias, e com ele Jesaías, dos filhos de Merari, com seus irmãos e os filhos deles, vinte;
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ασεβια καὶ τὸν Ωσαιαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Μεραρι ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν εἴκοσι

text_en: And of the Nathinites , whom David , and the princes gave for the service of the Levites , Nathinites two hundred and twenty: all these were called by their names .
text_la: et de Nathinæis, quos dederat David et principes ad ministeria Levitarum, Nathinæos ducentos viginti : omnes hi suis nominibus vocabantur.
text_pt: E dos servidores do templo que Davi e os príncipes deram para o ministério dos levitas, duzentos e vinte servidores do templo; que foram todos mencionados por seus nomes.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ναθινιμ ὧν ἔδωκεν Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες εἰς δουλείαν τῶν Λευιτῶν ναθινιμ διακόσιοι καὶ εἴκοσι πάντες συνήχθησαν ἐν ὀνόμασιν

text_en: And I proclaimed there a fast by the river Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before the Lord our God , and might ask of him a right way for us and for our children, and for all our substance.
text_la: Et prædicavi ibi jejunium juxta fluvium Ahava, ut affligeremur coram Domino Deo nostro, et peteremus ab eo viam rectam nobis et filiis nostris, universæque substantiæ nostræ.
text_pt: Então apregoei ali um jejum junto ao rio Aava, para nos humilharmos diante da face de nosso Deus, para lhe pedirmos caminho seguro para nós, para nossos filhos e para todos os nossos bens.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσα ἐκεῖ νηστείαν ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν Αουε τοῦ ταπεινωθῆναι ἐνώπιον θεοῦ ἡμῶν ζητῆσαι παρ' αὐτοῦ ὁδὸν εὐθεῖαν ἡμῖν καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν καὶ πάσῃ τῇ κτήσει ἡμῶν

text_en: For I was ashamed to ask the king for aid and for horsemen, to defend us from the enemy in the way: because we had said to the king: The hand of our God is upon all them that seek him in goodness: and his power and strength, and wrath upon all them that forsake him.
text_la: Erubui enim petere a rege auxilium et equites, qui defenderent nos ab inimico in via : quia dixeramus regi : Manus Dei nostri est super omnes qui quærunt eum in bonitate : et imperium ejus, et fortitudo ejus, et furor, super omnes qui derelinquunt eum.
text_pt: Porque tive vergonha de pedir ao rei exército e cavaleiros para nos defenderem do inimigo pelo caminho; porquanto tínhamos falado ao rei, dizendo: A mão do nosso Deus é sobre todos os que o buscam, para o bem deles; mas o seu poder e a sua ira contra todos os que o deixam.
text_el: ὅτι ᾐσχύνθην αἰτήσασθαι παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως δύναμιν καὶ ἱππεῖς σῶσαι ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ ἐχθροῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ὅτι εἴπαμεν τῷ βασιλεῖ λέγοντες χεὶρ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ζητοῦντας αὐτὸν εἰς ἀγαθόν καὶ κράτος αὐτοῦ καὶ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντας ἐγκαταλείποντας αὐτόν

text_en: And we fasted , and besought our God for this: and it fell out prosperously unto us.
text_la: Jejunavimus autem, et rogavimus Deum nostrum per hoc : et evenit nobis prospere.
text_pt: Nós, pois, jejuamos, e pedimos isto ao nosso Deus, e moveu-se pelas nossas orações.
text_el: καὶ ἐνηστεύσαμεν καὶ ἐζητήσαμεν παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν περὶ τούτου καὶ ἐπήκουσεν ἡμῖν

text_en: And I separated twelve of the chief of the priests , Sarabias, and Hasabias, and with them ten of their brethren,
text_la: Et separavi de principibus sacerdotum duodecim, Sarabiam, et Hasabiam, et cum eis de fratribus eorum decem:
text_pt: Então separei doze dos chefes dos sacerdotes: Serebias, Hasabias, e com eles dez dos seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ διέστειλα ἀπὸ ἀρχόντων τῶν ἱερέων δώδεκα τῷ Σαραια Ασαβια καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν ἀπὸ ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν δέκα

text_en: and I weighed unto them the silver and gold, and the vessels consecrated for the house of our God , which the king and his counsellors, and his princes, and all Israel , that were found had offered.
text_la: appendique eis argentum et aurum, et vasa consecrata domus Dei nostri, quæ obtulerat rex et consiliatores ejus, et principes ejus, universusque Israël eorum qui inventi fuerant:
text_pt: E pesei-lhes a prata, o ouro e os vasos; que eram a oferta para a casa de nosso Deus, que ofereceram o rei, os seus conselheiros, os seus príncipes e todo o Israel que ali se achou.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησα αὐτοῖς τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἀπαρχῆς οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἃ ὕψωσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ σύμβουλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ οἱ εὑρισκόμενοι

text_en: And I weighed to their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and a hundred vessels of silver, and a hundred talents of gold,
text_la: et appendi in manibus eorum argenti talenta sexcenta quinquaginta, et vasa argentea centum, auri centum talenta:
text_pt: E pesei em suas mãos seiscentos e cinqüenta talentos de prata, e em vasos de prata cem talentos, e cem talentos de ouro,
text_el: καὶ ἔστησα ἐπὶ χεῖρας αὐτῶν ἀργυρίου τάλαντα ἑξακόσια καὶ πεντήκοντα καὶ σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ ἑκατὸν καὶ τάλαντα χρυσίου ἑκατὸν

text_en: and twenty cups of gold, of a thousand solids, and two vessels of the best shining brass, beautiful as gold.
text_la: et crateres aureos viginti, qui habebant solidos millenos, et vasa æris fulgentis optimi duo, pulchra ut aurum.
text_pt: E vinte bacias de ouro, de mil dracmas, e dois vasos de bom metal lustroso, tão precioso como ouro.
text_el: καὶ καφουρη χρυσοῖ εἴκοσι εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν χαμανιμ χίλιοι καὶ σκεύη χαλκοῦ στίλβοντος ἀγαθοῦ διάφορα ἐπιθυμητὰ ἐν χρυσίῳ

text_en: And I said to them: You are the holy ones of the Lord , and the vessels are holy , and the silver and gold, that is freely offered to the Lord the God of our fathers.
text_la: Et dixi eis : Vos sancti Domini, et vasa sancta, et argentum et aurum, quod sponte oblatum est Domino Deo patrum nostrorum:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vós sois santos ao Senhor, e são santos estes utensílios, como também esta prata e este ouro, oferta voluntária, oferecida ao Senhor Deus de vossos pais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς ἅγιοι τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἅγια καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον ἑκούσια τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ πατέρων ὑμῶν

text_en: Watch and keep them, till you deliver them by weight before the chief of the priests , and of the Levites , and the heads of the families of Israel in Jerusalem , into the treasure of the house of the Lord .
text_la: vigilate et custodite, donec appendatis coram principibus sacerdotum, et Levitarum, et ducibus familiarum Israël in Jerusalem, in thesaurum domus Domini.
text_pt: Vigiai, pois, e guardai-os até que os peseis na presença dos chefes dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e dos chefes dos pais de Israel, em Jerusalém, nas câmaras da casa do Senhor.
text_el: ἀγρυπνεῖτε καὶ τηρεῖτε ἕως στῆτε ἐνώπιον ἀρχόντων τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν πατριῶν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ εἰς σκηνὰς οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: And the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and gold, and the vessels, to carry them to Jerusalem to the house of our God .
text_la: Susceperunt autem sacerdotes et Levitæ pondus argenti, et auri, et vasorum, ut deferrent Jerusalem in domum Dei nostri.
text_pt: Então os sacerdotes e os levitas receberam o peso da prata, do ouro e dos utensílios, para os trazerem a Jerusalém, à casa de nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐδέξαντο οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται σταθμὸν τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου καὶ τῶν σκευῶν ἐνεγκεῖν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: Then we set forward from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem : and the hand of our God was upon us, and delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
text_la: Promovimus ergo a flumine Ahava duodecimo die mensis primi ut pergeremus Jerusalem : et manus Dei nostri fuit super nos, et liberavit nos de manu inimici et insidiatoris in via.
text_pt: E partimos do rio Aava, no dia doze do primeiro mês, para irmos a Jerusalém; e a mão do nosso Deus estava sobre nós, e livrou-nos da mão dos inimigos, e dos que nos armavam ciladas pelo caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήραμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ Αουε ἐν τῇ δωδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἦν ἐφ' ἡμῖν καὶ ἐρρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ καὶ πολεμίου ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ

text_en: And we came to Jerusalem , and we stayed there three days.
text_la: Et venimus Jerusalem, et mansimus ibi tribus diebus.
text_pt: E chegamos a Jerusalém, e repousamos ali três dias.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθομεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐκαθίσαμεν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς

text_en: And on the fourth day the silver and the gold, and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Urias the priest , and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them Jozabad the son of Josue, and Noadaia the son of Benoi, Levites .
text_la: Die autem quarta appensum est argentum, et aurum, et vasa in domo Dei nostri per manum Meremoth filii Uriæ sacerdotis, et cum eo Eleazar filius Phinees, cumque eis Jozabed filius Josue, et Noadaia filius Bennoi Levitæ,
text_pt: E no quarto dia se pesou a prata, o ouro e os utensílios, na casa do nosso Deus, por mão de Meremote, filho do sacerdote Urias; e com ele Eleazar, filho de Finéias, e com eles Jozabade, filho de Jesuá, e Noadias, filho de Binui, levitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τετάρτῃ ἐστήσαμεν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ χεῖρα Μεριμωθ υἱοῦ Ουρια τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς Φινεες καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν Ιωζαβαδ υἱὸς Ἰησοῦ καὶ Νωαδια υἱὸς Βαναια οἱ Λευῖται

text_en: According to the number and weight of everything: and all the weight was written at that time.
text_la: juxta numerum et pondus omnium : descriptumque est omne pondus in tempore illo.
text_pt: Tudo foi contado e pesado; e todo o peso foi registrado na mesma ocasião.
text_el: ἐν ἀριθμῷ καὶ ἐν σταθμῷ τὰ πάντα καὶ ἐγράφη πᾶς ὁ σταθμός ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: Moreover the children of them that had been carried away that had come out of the captivity, offered holocausts to the God of Israel , twelve calves for all the people of Israel , ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve he goats for sin : all for a holocaust to the Lord .
text_la: Sed et qui venerant de captivitate filii transmigrationis, obtulerunt holocautomata Deo Israël, vitulos duodecim pro omni populo Israël, arietes nonaginta sex, agnos septuaginta septem, hircos pro peccato duodecim : omnia in holocaustum Domino.
text_pt: E os exilados, que vieram do cativeiro, ofereceram holocaustos ao Deus de Israel: doze novilhos por todo o Israel, noventa e seis carneiros, setenta e sete cordeiros, e doze bodes em sacrifício pelo pecado; tudo em holocausto ao Senhor.
text_el: οἱ ἐλθόντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας υἱοὶ τῆς παροικίας προσήνεγκαν ὁλοκαυτώσεις τῷ θεῷ Ισραηλ μόσχους δώδεκα περὶ παντὸς Ισραηλ κριοὺς ἐνενήκοντα ἕξ ἀμνοὺς ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ ἑπτά χιμάρους περὶ ἁμαρτίας δώδεκα τὰ πάντα ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And they gave the king's edicts to the lords that were from the king's court , and the governors beyond the river, and they furthered the people and the house of God .
text_la: Dederunt autem edicta regis satrapis qui erant de conspectu regis, et ducibus trans flumen, et elevaverunt populum et domum Dei.
text_pt: Então deram as ordens do rei aos seus sátrapas, e aos governadores dalém do rio; e estes ajudaram o povo e a casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν τὸ νόμισμα τοῦ βασιλέως τοῖς διοικηταῖς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐπάρχοις πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἐδόξασαν τὸν λαὸν καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And after these things were accomplished, the princes came to me, saying: The people of Israel , and the priests and Levites have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, and from their abominations, namely, of the Chanaanites , and the Hethites , and the Pherezites, and the Jebusites, and the Ammonites , and the Moabites , and the Egyptians , and the Amorrhites .
text_la: Postquam autem hæc completa sunt, accesserunt ad me principes, dicentes : Non est separatus populus Israël, sacerdotes et Levitæ, a populis terrarum et abominationibus eorum : Chananæi videlicet, et Hethæi, et Pherezæi, et Jebusæi, et Ammonitarum, et Moabitarum, et Ægyptiorum, et Amorrhæorum:
text_pt: Acabadas, pois, estas coisas, chegaram-se a mim os príncipes, dizendo: O povo de Israel, os sacerdotes e os levitas, não se têm separado dos povos destas terras, seguindo as abominações dos cananeus, dos heteus, dos perizeus, dos jebuseus, dos amonitas, dos moabitas, dos egípcios, e dos amorreus.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἐτελέσθη ταῦτα ἤγγισαν πρός με οἱ ἄρχοντες λέγοντες οὐκ ἐχωρίσθη ὁ λαὸς Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἀπὸ λαῶν τῶν γαιῶν ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν τῷ Χανανι ὁ Εθι ὁ Φερεζι ὁ Ιεβουσι ὁ Αμμωνι ὁ Μωαβι ὁ Μοσερι καὶ ὁ Αμορι

text_en: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, and they have mingled the holy seed with the people of the lands. And the hand of the princes and magistrates has been first in this transgression.
text_la: tulerunt enim de filiabus eorum sibi et filiis suis, et commiscuerunt semen sanctum cum populis terrarum : manus etiam principum et magistratuum fuit in transgressione hac prima.
text_pt: Porque tomaram das suas filhas para si e para seus filhos, e assim se misturou a linhagem santa com os povos dessas terras; e até os príncipes e magistrados foram os primeiros nesta transgressão.
text_el: ὅτι ἐλάβοσαν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων αὐτῶν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ παρήχθη σπέρμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐν λαοῖς τῶν γαιῶν καὶ χεὶρ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἐν τῇ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ ταύτῃ ἐν ἀρχῇ

text_en: And when I had heard this word, I rent my mantle and my coat, and plucked off the hairs of my head and my beard , and I sat down mourning.
text_la: Cumque audissem sermonem istum, scidi pallium meum et tunicam, et evelli capillos capitis mei et barbæ, et sedi mœrens.
text_pt: E, ouvindo eu tal coisa, rasguei as minhas vestes e o meu manto, e arranquei os cabelos da minha cabeça e da minha barba, e sentei-me atônito.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἤκουσα τὸν λόγον τοῦτον διέρρηξα τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ ἐπαλλόμην καὶ ἔτιλλον ἀπὸ τῶν τριχῶν τῆς κεφαλῆς μου καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πώγωνός μου καὶ ἐκαθήμην ἠρεμάζων

text_en: And there were assembled to me all that feared the God of Israel , because of the transgression of those that had come from the captivity, and I sat sorrowful, until the evening sacrifice .
text_la: Convenerunt autem ad me omnes qui timebant verbum Dei Israël, pro transgressione eorum qui de captivitate venerant, et ego sedebam tristis usque ad sacrificium vespertinum:
text_pt: Então se ajuntaram a mim todos os que tremiam das palavras do Deus de Israel por causa da transgressão dos do cativeiro; porém eu permaneci sentado atônito até ao sacrifício da tarde.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρός με πᾶς ὁ διώκων λόγον θεοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ τῆς ἀποικίας καὶ ἐγὼ καθήμενος ἠρεμάζων ἕως τῆς θυσίας τῆς ἑσπερινῆς

text_en: And at the evening sacrifice I rose up from my affliction, and having rent my mantle and my garment, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands to the Lord my God ,
text_la: et in sacrificio vespertino, surrexi de afflictione mea, et scisso pallio et tunica, curvavi genua mea, et expandi manus meas ad Dominum Deum meum.
text_pt: E perto do sacrifício da tarde me levantei da minha aflição, havendo já rasgado as minhas vestes e o meu manto, e me pus de joelhos, e estendi as minhas mãos para o Senhor meu Deus;
text_el: καὶ ἐν θυσίᾳ τῇ ἑσπερινῇ ἀνέστην ἀπὸ ταπεινώσεώς μου καὶ ἐν τῷ διαρρῆξαί με τὰ ἱμάτιά μου καὶ ἐπαλλόμην καὶ κλίνω ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατά μου καὶ ἐκπετάζω τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν

text_en: and said: My God I am confounded and ashamed to lift up my face to you: for our iniquities are multiplied over our heads, and our sins are grown up even unto heaven ,
text_la: Et dixi : Deus meus, confundor et erubesco levare faciem meam ad te : quoniam iniquitates nostræ multiplicatæ sunt super caput nostrum, et delicta nostra creverunt usque ad cælum,
text_pt: E disse: Meu Deus! Estou confuso e envergonhado, para levantar a ti a minha face, meu Deus; porque as nossas iniqüidades se multiplicaram sobre a nossa cabeça, e a nossa culpa tem crescido até aos céus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα κύριε ᾐσχύνθην καὶ ἐνετράπην τοῦ ὑψῶσαι τὸ πρόσωπόν μου πρὸς σέ ὅτι αἱ ἀνομίαι ἡμῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς ἡμῶν καὶ αἱ πλημμέλειαι ἡμῶν ἐμεγαλύνθησαν ἕως εἰς οὐρανόν

text_en: from the days of our fathers: and we ourselves also have sinned grievously unto this day, and for our iniquities we and our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the lands, and to the sword, and to captivity, and to spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is at this day.
text_la: a diebus patrum nostrorum : sed et nos ipsi peccavimus graviter usque ad diem hanc, et in iniquitatibus nostris traditi sumus ipsi, et reges nostri, et sacerdotes nostri, in manum regum terrarum, et in gladium, et in captivitatem, et in rapinam, et in confusionem vultus, sicut et die hac.
text_pt: Desde os dias de nossos pais até ao dia de hoje estamos em grande culpa, e por causa das nossas iniqüidades somos entregues, nós e nossos reis e os nossos sacerdotes, na mão dos reis das terras, à espada, ao cativeiro, e ao roubo, e à confusão do rosto, como hoje se vê.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐσμεν ἐν πλημμελείᾳ μεγάλῃ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις ἡμῶν παρεδόθημεν ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ ἡμῶν ἐν χειρὶ βασιλέων τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ καὶ ἐν διαρπαγῇ καὶ ἐν αἰσχύνῃ προσώπου ἡμῶν ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: And now as a little, and for a moment has our prayer been made before the Lord our God , to leave us a remnant, and give us a pin in his holy place, and that our God would enlighten our eyes, and would give us a little life in our bondage.
text_la: Et nunc quasi parum et ad momentum facta est deprecatio nostra apud Dominum Deum nostrum, ut dimitterentur nobis reliquiæ, et daretur nobis paxillus in loco sancto ejus, et illuminaret oculos nostros Deus noster, et daret nobis vitam modicam in servitute nostra:
text_pt: E agora, por um pequeno momento, se manifestou a graça da parte do Senhor, nosso Deus, para nos deixar alguns que escapem, e para dar-nos uma estaca no seu santo lugar; para nos iluminar os olhos, ó Deus nosso, e para nos dar um pouco de vida na nossa servidão.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐπιεικεύσατο ἡμῖν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τοῦ καταλιπεῖν ἡμῖν εἰς σωτηρίαν καὶ δοῦναι ἡμῖν στήριγμα ἐν τόπῳ ἁγιάσματος αὐτοῦ τοῦ φωτίσαι ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμῶν καὶ δοῦναι ζωοποίησιν μικρὰν ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ ἡμῶν

text_en: For we are bondmen, and in our bondage our God has not forsaken us, but has extended mercy upon us before the king of the Persians, to give us life, and to set up the house of our God , and to rebuild the desolations thereof, and to give us a fence in Juda and Jerusalem .
text_la: quia servi sumus, et in servitute nostra non dereliquit nos Deus noster, sed inclinavit super nos misericordiam coram rege Persarum, ut daret nobis vitam, et sublimaret domum Dei nostri, et exstrueret solitudines ejus, et daret nobis sepem in Juda et Jerusalem.
text_pt: Porque somos servos; porém na nossa servidão não nos desamparou o nosso Deus; antes estendeu sobre nós a sua benignidade perante os reis da Pérsia, para que nos desse vida, para levantarmos a casa do nosso Deus, e para restaurarmos as suas assolações; e para que nos desse uma parede de proteção em Judá e em Jerusalém.
text_el: ὅτι δοῦλοί ἐσμεν καὶ ἐν τῇ δουλείᾳ ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπεν ἡμᾶς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἔκλινεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἔλεος ἐνώπιον βασιλέων Περσῶν δοῦναι ἡμῖν ζωοποίησιν τοῦ ὑψῶσαι αὐτοὺς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ ἀναστῆσαι τὰ ἔρημα αὐτῆς καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν φραγμὸν ἐν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And now, O our God , what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,
text_la: Et nunc quid dicemus, Deus noster, post hæc? Quia dereliquimus mandata tua,
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó nosso Deus, que diremos depois disto? Pois deixamos os teus mandamentos,
text_el: τί εἴπωμεν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν μετὰ τοῦτο ὅτι ἐγκατελίπομεν ἐντολάς σου

text_en: which you have commanded by the hand of your servants the prophets , saying: The land which you go to possess, is an unclean land, according to the uncleanness of the people, and of other lands, with their abominations, who have filled it from mouth to mouth with their filth.
text_la: quæ præcepisti in manu servorum tuorum prophetarum, dicens : Terra, ad quam vos ingredimini ut possideatis eam, terra immunda est juxta immunditiam populorum, ceterarumque terrarum, abominationibus eorum qui repleverunt eam ab ore usque ad os in coinquinatione sua.
text_pt: Os quais mandaste pelo ministério de teus servos, os profetas, dizendo: A terra em que entrais para a possuir, terra imunda é pelas imundícias dos povos das terras, pelas suas abominações com que, na sua corrupção a encheram, de uma extremidade à outra.
text_el: ἃς ἔδωκας ἡμῖν ἐν χειρὶ δούλων σου τῶν προφητῶν λέγων ἡ γῆ εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεσθε κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν γῆ μετακινουμένη ἐστὶν ἐν μετακινήσει λαῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν ὧν ἔπλησαν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ στόματος ἐπὶ στόμα ἐν ἀκαθαρσίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: Now therefore give not your daughters to their sons, and take not their daughters for your sons, and seek not their peace, nor their prosperity for ever: that you may be strengthened, and may eat the good things of the land, and may have your children your heirs for ever.
text_la: Nunc ergo filias vestras ne detis filiis eorum, et filias eorum ne accipiatis filiis vestris, et non quæratis pacem eorum et prosperitatem eorum usque in æternum : ut confortemini, et comedatis quæ bona sunt terræ, et hæredes habeatis filios vestros usque in sæculum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, vossas filhas não dareis a seus filhos, e suas filhas não tomareis para vossos filhos, e nunca procurareis a sua paz e o seu bem; para que sejais fortes, e comais o bem da terra, e a deixeis por herança a vossos filhos para sempre.
text_el: καὶ νῦν τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν μὴ δῶτε τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῶν μὴ λάβητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἐκζητήσετε εἰρήνην αὐτῶν καὶ ἀγαθὸν αὐτῶν ἕως αἰῶνος ὅπως ἐνισχύσητε καὶ φάγητε τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς καὶ κληροδοτήσητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: And after all that has come upon us, for our most wicked deeds, and our great sin , seeing that you our God have saved us from our iniquity , and have given us a deliverance as at this day,
text_la: Et post omnia quæ venerunt super nos in operibus nostris pessimis, et in delicto nostro magno, quia tu, Deus noster, liberasti nos de iniquitate nostra, et dedisti nobis salutem sicut est hodie,
text_pt: E depois de tudo o que nos tem sucedido por causa das nossas más obras, e da nossa grande culpa, porquanto tu, ó nosso Deus, impediste que fôssemos destruídos, por causa da nossa iniqüidade, e ainda nos deste um remanescente como este;
text_el: καὶ μετὰ πᾶν τὸ ἐρχόμενον ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν ποιήμασιν ἡμῶν τοῖς πονηροῖς καὶ ἐν πλημμελείᾳ ἡμῶν τῇ μεγάλῃ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐκούφισας ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας καὶ ἔδωκας ἡμῖν σωτηρίαν

text_en: that we should not turn away, nor break your commandments, nor join in marriage with the people of these abominations. Are you angry with us unto utter destruction, not to leave us a remnant to be saved?
text_la: ut non converteremur, et irrita faceremus mandata tua, neque matrimonia jungeremus cum populis abominationum istarum. Numquid iratus es nobis usque ad consummationem, ne dimitteres nobis reliquias ad salutem?
text_pt: Tornaremos, pois, agora a violar os teus mandamentos e a aparentar-nos com os povos destas abominações? Não te indignarias tu assim contra nós até de todo nos consumir, até que não ficasse remanescente nem quem escapasse?
text_el: ὅτι ἐπεστρέψαμεν διασκεδάσαι ἐντολάς σου καὶ ἐπιγαμβρεῦσαι τοῖς λαοῖς τῶν γαιῶν μὴ παροξυνθῇς ἐν ἡμῖν ἕως συντελείας τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐγκατάλειμμα καὶ διασῳζόμενον

text_en: O Lord God of Israel , you are just : for we remain yet to be saved as at this day. Behold we are before you in our sin , for there can be no standing before you in this matter.
text_la: Domine Deus Israël, justus es tu : quoniam derelicti sumus, qui salvaremur sicut die hac. Ecce coram te sumus in delicto nostro : non enim stari potest coram te super hoc.
text_pt: Ah! Senhor Deus de Israel, justo és, pois ficamos qual um remanescente que escapou, como hoje se vê; eis que estamos diante de ti, na nossa culpa, porque ninguém há que possa estar na tua presença, por causa disto.
text_el: κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ δίκαιος σύ ὅτι κατελείφθημεν διασῳζόμενοι ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἐναντίον σου ἐν πλημμελείαις ἡμῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν στῆναι ἐνώπιόν σου ἐπὶ τούτῳ

text_en: Now when Esdras was thus praying , and beseeching, and weeping, and lying before the temple of God , there was gathered to him of Israel an exceeding great assembly of men and women and children, and the people wept with much lamentation.
text_la: Sic ergo orante Esdra, et implorante eo et flente, et jacente ante templum Dei, collectus est ad eum de Israël cœtus grandis nimis virorum et mulierum et puerorum, et flevit populus fletu multo.
text_pt: E enquanto Esdras orava, e fazia confissão, chorando e prostrando-se diante da casa de Deus, ajuntou-se a ele, de Israel, uma grande congregação de homens, mulheres e crianças; pois o povo chorava com grande choro.
text_el: καὶ ὡς προσηύξατο Εσδρας καὶ ὡς ἐξηγόρευσεν κλαίων καὶ προσευχόμενος ἐνώπιον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀπὸ Ισραηλ ἐκκλησία πολλὴ σφόδρα ἄνδρες καὶ γυναῖκες καὶ νεανίσκοι ὅτι ἔκλαυσεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ὕψωσεν κλαίων

text_en: And Sechenias the son of Jehiel of the sons of Elam answered, and said to Esdras : We have sinned against our God , and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: and now if there be repentance in Israel concerning this,
text_la: Et respondit Sechenias filius Jehiel de filiis Ælam, et dixit Esdræ : Nos prævaricati sumus in Deum nostrum, et duximus uxores alienigenas de populis terræ : et nunc, si est pœnitentia in Israël super hoc,
text_pt: Então Secanias, filho de Jeiel, um dos filhos de Elão, tomou a palavra e disse a Esdras: Nós temos transgredido contra o nosso Deus, e casamos com mulheres estrangeiras dentre os povos da terra, mas, no tocante a isto, ainda há esperança para Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Σεχενιας υἱὸς Ιιηλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηλαμ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Εσδρα ἡμεῖς ἠσυνθετήσαμεν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκαθίσαμεν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ νῦν ἔστιν ὑπομονὴ τῷ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τούτῳ

text_en: let us make a covenant with the Lord our God , to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the will of the Lord , and of them that fear the commandment of the Lord our God : let it be done according to the law.
text_la: percutiamus fœdus cum Domino Deo nostro, ut projiciamus universas uxores, et eos qui de his nati sunt, juxta voluntatem Domini, et eorum qui timent præceptum Domini Dei nostri : secundum legem fiat.
text_pt: Agora, pois, façamos aliança com o nosso Deus de que despediremos todas as mulheres, e os que delas são nascidos, conforme ao conselho do meu senhor, e dos que tremem ao mandado do nosso Deus; e faça-se conforme a lei.
text_el: καὶ νῦν διαθώμεθα διαθήκην τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἐκβαλεῖν πάσας τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ γενόμενα ἐξ αὐτῶν ὡς ἂν βούλῃ ἀνάστηθι καὶ φοβέρισον αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐντολαῖς θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ ὡς ὁ νόμος γενηθήτω

text_en: Arise, it is your part to give orders, and we will be with you: take courage , and do it.
text_la: Surge, tuum est decernere, nosque erimus tecum : confortare, et fac.
text_pt: Levanta-te, pois, porque te pertence este negócio, e nós seremos contigo; esforça-te, e age.
text_el: ἀνάστα ὅτι ἐπὶ σὲ τὸ ῥῆμα καὶ ἡμεῖς μετὰ σοῦ κραταιοῦ καὶ ποίησον

text_en: So Esdras arose, and made the chiefs of the priests and of the Levites , and all Israel , to swear that they would do according to this word, and they swore .
text_la: Surrexit ergo Esdras, et adjuravit principes sacerdotum et Levitarum, et omnem Israël, ut facerent secundum verbum hoc : et juraverunt.
text_pt: Então Esdras se levantou, e ajuramentou os chefes dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, e a todo o Israel, de que fariam conforme a esta palavra; e eles juraram.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Εσδρας καὶ ὥρκισεν τοὺς ἄρχοντας τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ Λευίτας καὶ πάντα Ισραηλ τοῦ ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ ὤμοσαν

text_en: And Esdras rose up from before the house of God , and went to the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliasib, and entered in thither: he ate no bread, and drank no water: for he mourned for the transgression of them that had come out of the captivity.
text_la: Et surrexit Esdras ante domum Dei, et abiit ad cubiculum Johanan filii Eliasib, et ingressus est illuc : panem non comedit, et aquam non bibit : lugebat enim transgressionem eorum, qui venerant de captivitate.
text_pt: E Esdras se levantou de diante da casa de Deus, e entrou na câmara de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe; e, chegando lá, não comeu pão, e nem bebeu água; porque lamentava pela transgressão dos do cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Εσδρας ἀπὸ προσώπου οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς γαζοφυλάκιον Ιωαναν υἱοῦ Ελισουβ καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖ ἄρτον οὐκ ἔφαγεν καὶ ὕδωρ οὐκ ἔπιεν ὅτι ἐπένθει ἐπὶ τῇ ἀσυνθεσίᾳ τῆς ἀποικίας

text_en: And proclamation was made in Juda and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should assemble together into Jerusalem .
text_la: Et missa est vox in Juda et in Jerusalem omnibus filiis transmigrationis, ut congregarentur in Jerusalem:
text_pt: E fizeram passar pregão por Judá e Jerusalém, a todos os que vieram do cativeiro, para que se ajuntassem em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ παρήνεγκαν φωνὴν ἐν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ πᾶσιν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς ἀποικίας τοῦ συναθροισθῆναι εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the ancients, all his substance should be taken away, and he should be cast out of the company of them that were returned from captivity.
text_la: et omnis qui non venerit in tribus diebus juxta consilium principum et seniorum, auferetur universa substantia ejus, et ipse abjicietur de cœtu transmigrationis.
text_pt: E que todo aquele que em três dias não viesse, segundo o conselho dos príncipes e dos anciãos, toda a sua fazenda se poria em interdito, e ele seria separado da congregação dos do cativeiro.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἂν μὴ ἔλθῃ εἰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας ὡς ἡ βουλὴ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἀναθεματισθήσεται πᾶσα ἡ ὕπαρξις αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς διασταλήσεται ἀπὸ ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἀποικίας

text_en: Then all the men of Juda , and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within three days, in the ninth month, the twentieth day of the month: and all the people sat in the street of the house of God , trembling because of the sin , and the rain.
text_la: Convenerunt igitur omnes viri Juda et Benjamin in Jerusalem tribus diebus : ipse est mensis nonus, vigesimo die mensis : et sedit omnis populus in platea domus Dei, trementes pro peccato, et pluviis.
text_pt: Então todos os homens de Judá e Benjamim em três dias se ajuntaram em Jerusalém; era o nono mês, aos vinte dias do mês; e todo o povo se assentou na praça da casa de Deus, tremendo por este negócio e por causa das grandes chuvas.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πάντες ἄνδρες Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ εἰς τὰς τρεῖς ἡμέρας οὗτος ὁ μὴν ὁ ἔνατος ἐν εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνὸς ἐκάθισεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἐν πλατείᾳ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ ἀπὸ θορύβου αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ χειμῶνος

text_en: And Esdras the priest stood up, and said to them: You have transgressed, and taken strange wives, to add to the sins of Israel .
text_la: Et surrexit Esdras sacerdos, et dixit ad eos : Vos transgressi estis, et duxistis uxores alienigenas, ut adderetis super delictum Israël.
text_pt: Então se levantou Esdras, o sacerdote, e disse-lhes: Vós tendes transgredido, e casastes com mulheres estrangeiras, aumentando a culpa de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς ἠσυνθετήκατε καὶ ἐκαθίσατε γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας τοῦ προσθεῖναι ἐπὶ πλημμέλειαν Ισραηλ

text_en: And now make confession to the Lord the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure, and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from your strange wives.
text_la: Et nunc date confessionem Domino Deo patrum vestrorum, et facite placitum ejus, et separamini a populis terræ, et ab uxoribus alienigenis.
text_pt: Agora, pois, fazei confissão ao Senhor Deus de vossos pais, e fazei a sua vontade; e apartai-vos dos povos das terras, e das mulheres estrangeiras.
text_el: καὶ νῦν δότε αἴνεσιν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν καὶ ποιήσατε τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ διαστάλητε ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γυναικῶν τῶν ἀλλοτρίων

text_en: And all the multitude answered and said with a loud voice: According to your word unto us, so be it done.
text_la: Et respondit universa multitudo, dixitque voce magna : Juxta verbum tuum ad nos, sic fiat.
text_pt: E respondeu toda a congregação, e disse em altas vozes: Assim seja, conforme às tuas palavras nos convém fazer.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία καὶ εἶπαν μέγα τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ποιῆσαι

text_en: But as the people are many, and it is time of rain, and we are not able to stand without, and it is not a work of one day or two, (for we have exceedingly sinned in this matter),
text_la: Verumtamen quia populus multus est, et tempus pluviæ, et non sustinemus stare foris, et opus non est diei unius vel duorum (vehementer quippe peccavimus in sermone isto),
text_pt: Porém o povo é muito, e também é tempo de grandes chuvas, e não se pode estar aqui fora; nem é obra de um dia nem de dois, porque somos muitos os que transgredimos neste negócio.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὁ λαὸς πολύς καὶ ὁ καιρὸς χειμερινός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν δύναμις στῆναι ἔξω καὶ τὸ ἔργον οὐκ εἰς ἡμέραν μίαν καὶ οὐκ εἰς δύο ὅτι ἐπληθύναμεν τοῦ ἀδικῆσαι ἐν τῷ ῥήματι τούτῳ

text_en: let rulers be appointed in all the multitude: and in all our cities, let them that have taken strange wives come at the times appointed, and with them the ancients and the judges of every city, until the wrath of our God be turned away from us for this sin .
text_la: constituantur principes in universa multitudine : et omnes in civitatibus nostris qui duxerunt uxores alienigenas veniant in temporibus statutis, et cum his seniores per civitatem et civitatem, et judices ejus, donec avertatur ira Dei nostri a nobis super peccato hoc.
text_pt: Ora, ponham-se os nossos líderes, por toda a congregação sobre este negócio; e todos os que em nossas cidades casaram com mulheres estrangeiras venham em tempos apontados, e com eles os anciãos de cada cidade, e os seus juízes, até que desviemos de nós o ardor da ira do nosso Deus, por esta causa.
text_el: στήτωσαν δὴ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν τῇ πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐν πόλεσιν ἡμῶν ὃς ἐκάθισεν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἐλθέτωσαν εἰς καιροὺς ἀπὸ συνταγῶν καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν πρεσβύτεροι πόλεως καὶ πόλεως καὶ κριταὶ τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι ὀργὴν θυμοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξ ἡμῶν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου

text_en: Then Jonathan the son of Azahel, and Jaasia the son of Thecua were appointed over this, and Mesollam and Sebethai, Levites , helped them:
text_la: Igitur Jonathan filius Azahel, et Jaasia filius Thecue, steterunt super hoc, et Messollam et Sebethai Levites adjuverunt eos:
text_pt: Porém, somente Jônatas, filho de Asael, e Jaseías, filho de Ticva, se opuseram a isto; e Mesulão, e Sabetai, levita, os ajudaram.
text_el: πλὴν Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Ασαηλ καὶ Ιαζια υἱὸς Θεκουε μετ' ἐμοῦ περὶ τούτου καὶ Μεσουλαμ καὶ Σαβαθαι ὁ Λευίτης βοηθῶν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the children of the captivity did so. And Esdras the priest , and the men heads of the families in the houses of their fathers, and all by their names , went and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
text_la: feceruntque sic filii transmigrationis. Et abierunt Esdras sacerdos, et viri principes familiarum, in domos patrum suorum, et omnes per nomina sua, et sederunt in die primo mensis decimi ut quærerent rem.
text_pt: E assim o fizeram os que voltaram do cativeiro; e o sacerdote Esdras e os homens, chefes dos pais, segundo a casa de seus pais, e todos pelos seus nomes, foram apontados; e assentaram-se no primeiro dia do décimo mês, para inquirirem neste negócio.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως υἱοὶ τῆς ἀποικίας καὶ διεστάλησαν Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ ἄνδρες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ πάντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν ὅτι ἐπέστρεψαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δεκάτου ἐκζητῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα

text_en: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
text_la: Et consummati sunt omnes viri, qui duxerant uxores alienigenas, usque ad diem primam mensis primi.
text_pt: E no primeiro dia do primeiro mês acabaram de tratar com todos os homens que casaram com mulheres estrangeiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐτέλεσαν ἐν πᾶσιν ἀνδράσιν οἳ ἐκάθισαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἕως ἡμέρας μιᾶς τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου

text_en: And there were found among the sons of the priests that had taken strange wives: Of the sons of Josue the son of Josedec, and his brethren, Maasia, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Godolia.
text_la: Et inventi sunt de filiis sacerdotum qui duxerant uxores alienigenas. De filiis Josue filii Josedec, et fratres ejus, Maasia, et Eliezer, et Jarib, et Godolia.
text_pt: E acharam-se dos filhos dos sacerdotes que casaram com mulheres estrangeiras: Dos filhos de Jesuá, filho de Jozadaque, e seus irmãos, Maaséias, e Eliezer, e Jaribe, e Gedalias.
text_el: καὶ εὑρέθησαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων οἳ ἐκάθισαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰησοῦ υἱοῦ Ιωσεδεκ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Μαασηα καὶ Ελιεζερ καὶ Ιαριβ καὶ Γαδαλια

text_en: And they gave their hands to put away their wives, and to offer for their offence a ram of the flock.
text_la: Et dederunt manus suas ut ejicerent uxores suas, et pro delicto suo arietem de ovibus offerrent.
text_pt: E deram as suas mãos prometendo que despediriam suas mulheres; e, achando-se culpados, ofereceram um carneiro do rebanho pelo seu delito.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν χεῖρα αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐξενέγκαι γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ πλημμελείας κριὸν ἐκ προβάτων περὶ πλημμελήσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: And of the sons of Emmer, Hanani, and Zebedia.
text_la: Et de filiis Emmer, Hanani, et Zebedia.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Imer: Hanani e Zebadias.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Εμμηρ Ανανι καὶ Ζαβδια

text_en: And of the sons of Harim, Maasia, and Elia, and Semeia, and Jehiel, and Ozias .
text_la: Et de filiis Harim, Maasia, et Elia, et Semeia, et Jehiel, et Ozias.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Harim: Maaséias, Elias, Semaías, Jeiel e Uzias.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηραμ Μασαια καὶ Ελια καὶ Σαμαια καὶ Ιιηλ καὶ Οζια

text_en: And of the sons of Pheshur, Elioenai, Maasia, Ismael, Nathanael, Jozabed, and Elasa.
text_la: Et de filiis Pheshur, Elioënai, Maasia, Ismaël, Nathanaël, Jozabed, et Elasa.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Pasur: Elioenai, Maaséias, Ismael, Netanel, Jozabade e Eleasa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φασουρ Ελιωηναι Μαασαια καὶ Ισμαηλ καὶ Ναθαναηλ καὶ Ιωζαβαδ καὶ Ηλασα

text_en: And of the sons of the Levites , Jozabed, and Semei, and Celaia, the same is Calita, Phataia, Juda , and Eliezer.
text_la: Et de filiis Levitarum, Jozabed, et Semei, et Celaia, ipse est Calita, Phataia, Juda, et Eliezer.
text_pt: E dos levitas: Jozabade, Simei, Quelaías (este é Quelita), Petaías, Judá e Eliezer.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευιτῶν Ιωζαβαδ καὶ Σαμου καὶ Κωλια αὐτὸς Κωλιτας καὶ Φαθαια καὶ Ιοδομ καὶ Ελιεζερ

text_en: And of the singing men , Elisiab: and of the porters, Sellum, and Telem, and Uri.
text_la: Et de cantoribus, Eliasib. Et de janitoribus, Sellum, et Telem, et Uri.
text_pt: E dos cantores: Eliasibe; e dos porteiros: Salum, Telém e Uri.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ᾀδόντων Ελισαφ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πυλωρῶν Σελλημ καὶ Τελημ καὶ Ωδουε

text_en: And of Israel , of the sons of Pharos, Remeia, and Jezia, and Melchia, and Miamin, and Eliezer, and Melchia, and Banea.
text_la: Et ex Israël, de filiis Pharos, Remeia, et Jesia, et Melchia, et Miamin, et Eliezer, et Melchia, et Banea.
text_pt: E de Israel, dos filhos de Parós: Ramias, Jezias, Malquias, Miamim, Eleazar, Malquias e Benaia.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φορος Ραμια καὶ Ιαζια καὶ Μελχια καὶ Μεαμιν καὶ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ασαβια καὶ Βαναια

text_en: And of the sons of Elam, Mathania, Zacharias, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jerimoth, and Elia.
text_la: Et de filiis Ælam, Mathania, Zacharias, et Jehiel, et Abdi, et Jerimoth, et Elia.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Elão: Matanias, Zacarias, Jeiel, Abdi, Jeremote e Elias.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηλαμ Μαθανια καὶ Ζαχαρια καὶ Ιαϊηλ καὶ Αβδια καὶ Ιαριμωθ καὶ Ηλια

text_en: And of the sons of Zethua, Elioenai, Eliasib, Mathania, Jerimuth, and Zabad, and Aziaza.
text_la: Et de filiis Zethua, Elioënai, Eliasib, Mathania, et Jerimuth, et Zabad, et Aziza.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Zatu: Elioenai, Eliasibe, Matanias, Jeremote, Zabade e Aziza.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ζαθουα Ελιωηναι Ελισουβ Μαθανια καὶ Ιαρμωθ καὶ Ζαβαδ καὶ Οζιζα

text_en: And of the sons of Babai, Johanan, Hanania, Zabbai, Athalai:
text_la: Et de filiis Bebai, Johanan, Hanania, Zabbai, Athalai.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Bebai: Joanã, Hananias, Zabai e Atlai.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βαβι Ιωαναν Ανανια καὶ Ζαβου Οθαλι

text_en: And of the sons of Bani, Mosollam, and Melluch, and Adaia, Jasub, and Saal, and Ramoth.
text_la: Et de filiis Bani, Mosollam, et Melluch, et Adaia, Jasub, et Saal, et Ramoth.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Bani: Mesulão, Maluque, Adaías, Jasube, Seal, Jeremote.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βανουι Μεσουλαμ Μαλουχ Αδαιας Ιασουβ καὶ Σαλουια καὶ Ρημωθ

text_en: And of the sons of Phahath, Moab , Edna, and Chalal, Banaias , and Maasias, Mathanias, Beseleel , Bennui, and Manasse.
text_la: Et de filiis Phahath Moab, Edna, et Chalal, Banaias, et Maasias, Mathanias, Beseleel, Bennui, et Manasse.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Paate-Moabe: Adna, Quelal, Benaia, Maséias, Matanias, Bezalel, Binui e Manassés.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φααθμωαβ Εδενε Χαληλ Βαναια Μασηα Μαθανια Βεσεληλ καὶ Βανουι καὶ Μανασση

text_en: And of the sons of Herem, Eliezer, Josue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,
text_la: Et de filiis Herem, Eliezer, Josue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,
text_pt: E dos filhos de Harim: Eliezer, Josias, Malquias, Semaías, Simeão,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηραμ Ελιεζερ Ιεσσια Μελχια Σαμαια Σεμεων

text_en: Benjamin, Maloch, Samarias.
text_la: Benjamin, Maloch, Samarias.
text_pt: Benjamim, Maluque, Semarias.

text_la: Et de filiis Hasom, Mathanai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jermai, Manasse, Semei.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Hasum: Matenai, Matatá, Zabade, Elifelete, Jeremai, Manassés e Simei.

text_la: De filiis Bani, Maadi, Amram, et Vel,

text_en: Mathanias, Mathania, and Jasi,
text_la: Mathanias, Mathanai, et Jasi,
text_pt: Matanias, Matnai e Jaasai,

text_en: and Bani, and Bennui, Semei,
text_la: et Bani, et Bennui, Semei,

text_la: et Salmias, et Nathan, et Adaias,

text_en: Of the sons of Nebo, Jehiel, Mathathias , Zabad, Zabina, Jeddu, and Joel, and Banaia.
text_la: De filiis Nebo, Jehiel, Mathathias, Zabad, Zabina, Jeddu, et Joël, et Banaia.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Nebo: Jeiel, Matitias, Zabade, Zebina, Jadai, Joel e Benaia.
text_el: ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ναβου Ιιηλ Μαθαθια Σεδεμ Ζαμβινα Ιαδαι καὶ Ιωηλ καὶ Βαναια

text_en: All these had taken strange wives, and there were among them women that had borne children.
text_la: Omnes hi acceperant uxores alienigenas, et fuerunt ex eis mulieres, quæ pepererant filios.
text_pt: Todos estes tomaram mulheres estrangeiras; e alguns deles tinham mulheres de quem tiveram filhos.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι ἐλάβοσαν γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας καὶ ἐγέννησαν ἐξ αὐτῶν υἱούς
